Item 2: "menjadi tumbuhan liar" for "naturalized" is wrong. Use "ternaturalisasi" or "menjadi naturalisasi". "Liar" suggests a weed, which changes the meaning.
Item 3: "mesh areas" is translated "daerah berawa" (swampy areas). This is likely a guess, since "mesh" is probably an error in the source for "marsh". It is acceptable, but check it.
Item 4: "growth is then moderate to high" is translated "sedang hingga cepat". Prefer "sedang hingga tinggi" to stay faithful to the source.

Item 4: "it may lose its colours and turn green" is translated "warnanya bisa memudar dan berubah menjadi hijau". This is fine, but "Bentuk emersed ... hanya bisa bertahan di dalam ruangan" should say "di musim dingin hanya bisa bertahan di dalam ruangan". Keep the meaning clear.
Item 5: "narrow to broadly elliptic" is translated "sempit hingga lonjong lebar". Use "elips sempit hingga lebar" for botanical accuracy.
Item 5: "fully submerged it barely reaches 15 cm" is translated "hampir tidak mencapai 15 cm". Use "hanya mencapai sekitar 15 cm"; "hampir tidak" implies it does not grow at all.
Item 4: "Liquid fertilizers are required at least a few times a month" is translated "Pupuk cair wajib diberikan minimal beberapa kali sebulan". This is acceptable, but "wajib" is a bit strong.

Item 8: "Menghitam ... disebabkan oleh air sadah" is fine, but "Layu: tanaman emersed yang direndam" says leaves are "belum beradaptasi"; the English means not adapted at all ("tidak cocok/tidak teradaptasi"). Minor.

Item 7: "lebih menyukai sinar matahari langsung yang berkurang" is awkward and could be misread as liking direct sun. Use "menyukai cahaya matahari langsung yang minim / terlindung dari sinar matahari langsung".
Item 7: "tanaman ini tetap baik tanpa pupuk rutin, tetapi tetap disarankan" repeats "tetap" and is clumsy. Use "tanaman ini tumbuh baik tanpa pupuk rutin, tetapi tetap disarankan ...".
Item 8: "white cloud" is incomplete for white cloud mountain minnow. Use "white cloud mountain minnow" or "ikan white cloud".

Item 8: "Anak daun fertil" for fertile leaflets is ok, but "Anak daun samping (pinna)" and later "anak daun" for leaflets are used inconsistently. Item 5 "setiap potongan memiliki minimal 3 anak daun" is ambiguous. Use "helai daun".
Item 8: "ikan mas koki" for goldfish is wrong. "Ikan mas" is goldfish and "koki" is a fancy variety. Use "ikan mas/koki".

Item 3: "far from being rare" is rendered "sama sekali tidak langka". This overstates the English, which says "far from rare". Use "jauh dari langka" or "sama sekali tidak langka" only if you keep the nuance.

Item 4: The English says the species is widely distributed in South America. This is fine, but the source says "originate from Venezuela" while item 5 lists the type locality as Rio Branco. Check that the specimen origin is consistent.
Item 6: "secluded" is rendered "terlindung dan tersembunyi". The doubled wording is redundant. Use "akuarium yang tenang/terlindung".
Item 7: Sentence structure and meaning are fine. "jelas paling sering" for "most often obviously" is slightly off. Use "tampaknya paling sering", because "obviously" is hedged.
Item 9: "press the tail on the side of the body" is rendered "menekuk ekornya". "Menekuk" (bend) changes "press against". Use "menempelkan ekornya ke sisi tubuh".

Item 11: "slender 2 rayed dorsal fin" is rendered "sirip punggung ramping dengan 2 jari-jari". This is acceptable, but "The Amaralia genus have" should be checked. Also "Least Concern (Berisiko Rendah)" in item 2 is fine.
Item 12: The reference list is left untranslated, which is correct.

Item 1: "will not swim even an inch" became "tidak akan berenang sedikit pun" (will not swim at all). This loses the idea of barely moving and reads as if they never swim. Suggest "hampir tidak mau berenang sedikit pun" or "tidak akan berenang sejauh apa pun".
Item 1: "much reduced dorsal fin" became "sirip punggungnya yang sangat kecil". This is acceptable but loses "reduced". Suggest "sirip punggung yang sangat mengecil/tereduksi".
Item 2: Temperature and pH ranges are unchanged, but "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)" is an odd gloss. Indonesian usage is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Least Concern". Minor.
Item 6: "secluded tank" became "akuarium yang tenang dan terlindung". "tenang" is an added fact. Suggest "akuarium yang tersembunyi/terlindung".

Item 7: "obviously on loricariids" became "tampaknya" (apparently), which weakens "obviously". Also "burayak" for freshly hatched fish is fine, but "dengan kantong kuning telur besar dari spesies ikan lain" is ambiguous about what belongs to what. Suggest rephrasing.
Item 8: "Tablet foods are also taken" is fine. "tubifex" became "cacing sutra", which is acceptable. No change needed here.

Item 11: "slender 2 rayed dorsal fin" became "sirip punggung ramping dengan 2 jari-jari". This is acceptable. "-ia, milik" is a literal rendering of "belonging to" and is awkward. Suggest "akhiran -ia, bermakna 'milik'".
Item 11: "caudal peduncle" became "pangkal ekor (batang ekor)". Prefer the single standard term "batang ekor".
Item 12: The reference list is left untranslated, as allowed.
Item 14: "bisa tersengat panas hingga melukai dirinya" is awkward; use "bisa terbakar" or "melukai dirinya karena panas".
Item 23: "Hanya ada satu laporan pemijahan" is ambiguous. Say "hanya ada satu laporan pembiakan", because the source is about a breeding report, not spawning at large.

Item 23: "No adults were collected in water about 45 cm deep" is rendered fine, but "semi-aquatic reeds" became "alang-alang yang tumbuh di tepi air". Use "alang-alang semi-akuatik" to avoid adding a fact ("tepi air", the water's edge).
Item 22: "Belum berhasil dipijahkan di akuarium" is fine, but "sarang busa" should be "sarang gelembung" (the common hobby term for a bubble nest).

Item 4: "Ada perbedaan warna antara jantan dan betina sampai batas tertentu" is a loose rendering of "sexual dichromatism". Clearer: "dikromatisme seksual" or "perbedaan warna antara jantan dan betina yang tidak terlalu jelas".
Item 16: "Ikan ini bisa makan sampai kekenyangan hingga perutnya tampak seperti mau meledak" is redundant. Say "makan sangat banyak hingga perutnya tampak hampir pecah".
Item 5: "bagus" is weak for "very nice", and "pemula di hobi ini" is stiff. Say "pemula dalam hobi akuarium".
Item 1/24: "Hancock's doradid" and "blue-eyed catfish" are left in English, which is acceptable. "catfish doradid" is mixed. Prefer "lele doradid" or keep "catfish" consistently.
Item 19: "Spesies ini kurang disukai penduduk setempat" is fine. "wading person" -> "orang yang berjalan di air" is okay, but "aduh!" is slightly informal for a handbook.
Item 9: "leaves these retreats to feed in large schools by night" is fine, but item 1/24: "sangat pemalu" for "secretive" changes meaning slightly; use "suka bersembunyi".

Item 23: "Tidak ada ikan dewasa yang tertangkap di air sedalam sekitar 45 cm itu" adds "itu" and a specific context; fine, but "semi-akuatik" for reeds is awkward; use "alang-alang yang tumbuh di tepi air".

Item 22: "sarang busa ... di antara tanaman di permukaan air" is OK, but item 22 says "Belum berhasil dipijahkan" while item 23 says "bertelur dengan cara menyebarkan telurnya" in aquarium. This contradiction comes from the source; make wording consistent without adding facts.
Item 14: "bisa terluka bakar" - use "bisa tersengat panas/melukai dirinya"; "burn themselves" is OK but "heater" is better as "pemanas (heater)".
Item 2: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" fine; "Kesadahan" for Hardness fine.
Item 17: "catfish lain seperti doradid lain" is repetitive; use "seperti doradid lainnya".
Item 18: "cocok dengan sesamanya" is a bit vague for "does well with its conspecifics"; use "akur dengan sesamanya".
Item 5: "sangat menarik" for "very nice" is acceptable but "bagus" is closer.
Item 21: "penghobi" for keepers fine; item 20 "seiring bertambah dewasa" should be "seiring bertambahnya usia/saat dewasa".
Item 24: "mengerutkan dan mengendurkan" fine; "luka yang sangat menyakitkan" for "eye-watering wound" OK.
Item 1 temperature: English range "2–30°C (36–86°F)" is fine, but "Max size 55 mm SL" etc. OK; no issue. Real problem is in item 11 and 8.

Item 8: "Its particular water requirements" is rendered "Kebutuhan airnya yang khusus", but the original also says "we strongly recommend"; that is fine. However "precarious" became "rawan", which is OK.
Item 11: "Hrnek et al., 2002" is used in the text, while the source reference list says "Hrbek". Use "Hrbek et al., 2002" (the English text typo was copied).
Item 10: "air dengan kimia dan suhu yang sama" is unnatural. Use "air dengan parameter kimia dan suhu yang sama".
Item 11: "dunia hobi" and "kutu air" for Daphnia (item 7) are non-standard. Use "kutu air (Daphnia)" or just "Daphnia". "Kutu air" is acceptable but ambiguous.
Item 11: "kerabat segenusnya" is awkward. Use "spesies sekerabatnya dalam genus yang sama".
Item 5: "Betina dan jantan yang kurang dominan harus diberi kesempatan untuk menghindar" is fine, but "boleh dipakai kalau suka" is too casual for a handbook. Use "jika diinginkan".
Item 3: "hipersalin" and "sangat asin" are fine. "Ditumbuhi lebat oleh alga... maupun tanaman tepian" is awkward and slightly ambiguous.

Item 1: "sehingga tercantum dua kali di Daftar Merah IUCN" makes the double listing a result of the names, but it is not clearly 'as a result' of the synonyms; acceptable, but "variable scalation" -> "sisiknya bervariasi" is fine. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 11: "Spesies-spesies ini dicantumkan secara terpisah agar tidak perlu memakai nama subspesies" is fine, but "Meski Aphanius jelas tidak secerah" is OK. Real issue: "Akibat kerancuan ini" fine.
Item 10: "Anatolichthys biasanya memakan telur/burayaknya sendiri" adds "sendiri" (their own), which is not in the source; remove it.

Item 10: "diganti setiap dua hari sekali" is wrong for "every couple of days" (a couple of days = about 2 days; "setiap dua hari sekali" is redundant). Use "setiap dua hari" or "setiap beberapa hari".
Item 10: "air dengan kimia dan suhu yang sama" is unnatural; use "kimia air dan suhu yang sama".
Item 8: "sangat disarankan untuk memeliharanya sendirian" is ambiguous: it could mean one fish alone. Use "tanpa ikan spesies lain" (maintain it on its own, as a single-species tank).
Item 4: "Sebaiknya dipelihara dalam kelompok yang cukup besar" loses "larger group"; use "kelompok yang lebih besar". Also "minimal 120 × 30 cm" matches "upwards of" but check tone.
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "upaya reproduksi" is stiff; "karena aktivitas berbiaknya yang tinggi" is more natural.
Item 11: "Kecil kemungkinan ikan ini dijual" and "breeder" are fine. "hasil variasi gen yang tidak terduga" fine.

Item 2: "tempat musim dingin" for "wintering ground" is awkward; use "tempat singgah/menetap selama musim dingin". "Lahan Basah Ramsar yang Penting secara Internasional" is a stiff rendering; use "Lahan Basah Ramsar yang Penting secara Internasional (situs Ramsar)".
Item 6: the English gives 'Hardness: 15 - 30°H'. The Indonesian keeps '°H', which is fine. But 'Temperature ... 2–30 °C' is correct and the 'winter' advice is kept. No change needed there.

Item 5: 'Java moss or Ceratophyllum ... may fail to thrive as the addition of marine salt ... is necessary'. The Indonesian says 'air perlu ditambah garam laut', which is acceptable. 'kalau suka' is too casual for a handbook. Use 'jika diinginkan'.

Item 10: 'Individu dominan akan menampilkan warna yang lebih pekat' is fine. But 'Anatolichthys biasanya memakan telur/burayaknya sendiri' adds 'sendiri' (their own). The English only says they eat eggs/fry, so drop 'sendiri'.

Item 3: 'aquifiers' and the 'unidentified Chara species' are fine. 'teluk-teluk kecil' for 'inlets' suggests bays of the lake. Better is 'muara/aliran masuk' (inlets or streams), since item 11 describes movement into neighbouring streams.

Item 11: 'baru pada 2003 sebuah komite ICZN memutuskan untuk menekan nama tersebut' is fine. But 'Hrbek et al. (2002) mengusulkan ... klad' keeps the English citation style, which is acceptable. 'kutu air' for Daphnia (item 7) is a common local term but ambiguous. Prefer 'daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)'.
Item 11: 'Kawasan Anatolia ... sepuluh spesies endemik' is faithful. 'kompleks spesies A. anatoliae' is fine. 'berteori' is stiff. Use 'berpendapat' or 'mengemukakan teori'.
Item 8: 'sangat disarankan dipelihara tersendiri' drops the 'we' and is fine. Item 9: 'garis vertikal' for 'bars' is fine. 'perbedaan jantan dan betina sangat jelas' is natural and needs no change.
Item 5: "angka lain yang disebutkan juga berada di kisaran yang sama" is vague. Either drop the redundant second figure or state it as 23–27 °C.
Items 2 and 6: "lele" for Ancistrus and for catfish in general is loose. Hobbyists would say "ikan catfish" or "pleco", because loricariids are not true lele.
Items 8 and 9: "bristle (duri)" and "duri/bristle" are inconsistent. Pick one term, e.g. "bristle (juluran seperti duri)", and use it consistently.

Item 1: "Ciri ini khas genus Ancistrus dan tidak dimiliki genus lain" adds a claim (not found in other genera) beyond the source "unique to the genus Ancistrus"; also the unit "79 mm" is fine, but "Kotamadya Bonito" for Município is slightly off (use "Munisipalitas/Kota Bonito").
Item 5: "tidak pernah selebat pada jantan" – "selebat" (bushy) changes meaning; source says "never to the extent seen in the male" (tidak sebesar/sebanyak jantan).
Item 6: "bertelur di dalam gua atau celah" adds "celah" (crevice) not in source; cave-breeders = "pemijah gua". Also "young fry" = burayak is fine.
Item 3: "timun (jenis timun Inggris)" – better "mentimun Inggris (English cucumber)"; "pakan hewani" for "meaty foods" is OK. "sebagian besar nabati" acceptable.
Item 1: "Daftar Merah IUCN: Rentan" fine; "Blind Cave Bristlenose" left in English without a local rendering is acceptable as trade name.
Item 4: 'Volume: ~365 litres' kept as is, but fine. Main issue: Item 11 'Cyclocheilichthys ... (berisi C. enoplos)' fine; however 'Kalau data ukuran maksimumnya memang benar' is ok.
Item 1/4: '280 mm SL' converted to '28 cm SL' is correct, but 'Panjang standar: 28 cm SL' is redundant; use 'Panjang standar: 28 cm'.
Item 5: 'kayu apung' for driftwood is misleading (means floating wood); use 'kayu driftwood' or 'akar/kayu rendaman'.
Item 5: 'Cryptocoryne spp. dalam pot' - 'beberapa Cryptocoryne spp.' is awkward; use 'beberapa jenis Cryptocoryne'.
Item 8: 'teman setangki' is a non-standard term; use 'ikan penghuni lain/tankmate'. Also 'dengan beberapa pilihan menarik' repeats 'menarik'.
Item 7: 'pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran kering' is redundant; use 'pakan serpih dan pelet kering'.
Item 3: 'merumput biofilm kaya nutrisi' adds 'nutrisi' (English says 'rich biofilm'); acceptable but could be 'biofilm yang melimpah'.
Item 11: 'dari nama lokal ikan ini' - 'a local vernacular name' fine; 'divalidasi ulang' for 'revalidated' acceptable.
Item 1: "Ukurannya bisa mencapai sekitar 280 mm SL" keeps mm. Prefer cm ("sekitar 28 cm SL"), consistent with the metric convention. Same for item 4 "280 mm SL". Minor.
Item 8: "Pada dasarnya ikan ini suka hidup berkelompok" is a loose rendering of "gregarious by nature"; "secara alami" is better. Minor.
Item 3: "Pada dasarnya ini ikan sungai" is awkward for "Primarily a riverine fish"; use "Terutama ikan sungai". Minor.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp. dalam pot" is fine, but "substrat pasir yang halus" drops "soft". Minor.
Item 11: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the more common hobby term. Minor.
Item 11: "bibir yang menyambung" for "continuous lips" is slightly unclear; use "bibir yang bersambungan". Minor.

Item 4: "Kalau data ukuran maksimumnya memang benar" is fine. Item 5: "Beberapa kelompok tanaman apung" is fine. Item 10: "diperkirakan belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan" slightly changes "Not thought to have been bred"; use "Tampaknya belum pernah dibiakkan".
Item 10: "gerombolan besar" sounds like a gang or band. Use "kawanan besar" or "gerombol" for shoals of fish.
Item 4: "julukan spesies ogoense" – 'specific epithet' is more standard as "epitet spesifik"; "julukan" is slightly informal.
Item 4: "berhias, sering kali berbentuk lira" is slightly awkward; consider "berhias, sering berbentuk seperti lira".

Item 10: "Less eggs tend to fungus using the latter method" is rendered correctly, but "burayak" for fry is regional/less common. "Anakan" and "burayak" are mixed, so use one term consistently, e.g. "burayak" or "anakan ikan".
Item 10: "jumlah anakan cenderung lebih sedikit" translates "brood sizes". Say "jumlah burayak yang dihasilkan" or "jumlah telur per pemijahan" to be consistent.
Item 10: "peat" is used loosely in "filtrasi dengan peat". Use "filtrasi gambut (peat)" consistently, or keep "peat moss" only for the substrate.
Items 1, 5, 10: "Splendid lyretail" is left untranslated as a common name. Consider adding a local form such as "ekor lira", or keep the English trade name.
Item 10: "menggunakan filter spons kecil ... bukan ide yang buruk" is a clumsy sentence. Add "tetapi" or restructure it: "menggunakan filter spons kecil ... tidaklah buruk".
Item 10: "peternak" for "breeders" is awkward in the aquarium hobby. Use "pembiak" or "penghobi/pembudidaya".
Item 10: "pakan yang lebih besar dan pakan beku" is correct, but "velvet" should be "penyakit beludru (velvet)".
Item 8: "saling teritorial" is awkward. Use "bersikap teritorial satu sama lain".
Item 11: 'Burayaknya' / 'burayak' is the term for fry, which is fine, but 'peternak' for breeders is awkward; use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi' instead.
Item 11: 'air yang diisi ... setinggi 2,5–5 cm' is fine, but 'dibibit' for 'seeded' is awkward; use 'diberi starter pakan' or 'diinokulasi'.
Item 11: 'air harus dibuat sangat dangkal' is fine, but 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' should read 'filter spons yang digerakkan udara (aerator)'.
Items 2/9: 'teman setanknya' is a bit informal; 'penghuni akuarium lain' is more natural.
Item 9: 'ikan cyprinid' and 'Loricariid kecil' are left as English terms; consider 'ikan sejenis Cyprinidae' or the local names.
Item 2/12: 'annual' is left untranslated; consider 'spesies annual (musiman)' for clarity.
Item 12: 'jari-jari ... sirip punggung' is acceptable, but 'garis vertikal' for 'vertical bars' is better as 'pita/garis tegak'.

Item 5: "Asalkan tersedia cukup tempat bersembunyi dan struktur" – English says "cover and structure"; "tempat bersembunyi" is acceptable, but "gua" for caves is better rendered as "gua-gua kecil/celah persembunyian".
Item 5: "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari; ganti air 10–15% per minggu sudah cukup" is fine, but "kepadatan ikan ... rendah" could be more natural as "tidak padat penghuni".

Item 2: "kota/kabupaten (municipio)" is awkward; use just "kota (municipality) Codajás" or "kotamadya". Also "sedikit di hulu kota Manaus" is slightly vague for "just upstream"; use "tepat di sebelah hulu".
Item 9: "lebih berwarna" is awkward; use "warnanya lebih mencolok". "sirip yang lebih panjang" for "more extended fins" is acceptable.
Item 10: "agresif/galak" with slash is clumsy; choose one, e.g. "sangat agresif". "hyper-aggressive" is also better as "sangat agresif".
Item 11: "Spesies ini juga diberi nomor 'A' A234" is awkward; use "nomor 'A' yaitu A234". "hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is fine.
Item 11: "sub-garis keturunan" and "garis keturunan (lineage)" are unnatural for "sublineage/lineage"; consider keeping "sublineage"/"lineage" as the hobby terms.
Item 1: "kali kecil" for creeks is slightly colloquial; "anak sungai kecil" or "sungai kecil" is more standard.
Item 3: 'white' water translated as "air keruh (whitewater)" – whitewater is not simply 'turbid' water; use "air putih (whitewater)" or "air keruh berlumpur (whitewater)" for accuracy.
Item 2: "Saat ini spesies ini diterima tersebar" is garbled; rephrase as "Saat ini diakui sebaran spesies ini mencakup ...".
Item 2: 'upstream from Manaus' – "sedikit di hulu kota Manaus" is ok, but 'municipality' as "munisipalitas" is stiff; use "kota/kabupaten (municipio) Codajás".

Item 10: "Betina yang mengurus telur dan burayak" – 'hyper-aggressive' rendered only as "sangat agresif"; use "sangat agresif/galak" and note she guards fry; also "burayak" is less common than "anakan" among hobbyists.
Item 11: 'lineage' left untranslated and 'near-constant flux' as "hampir selalu berubah" is fine, but "oleh ikan-ikan yang muncul" is awkward; use "dengan tambahan ikan-ikan yang muncul di pasar".
Item 11: "genus cichlid ... dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak" – 'among the most speciose' should be "salah satu ... dengan spesies terbanyak"; current wording implies the single most.
Item 4/1: 'dither' fishes and "kutu air" for Daphnia: Daphnia is commonly "daphnia"/"kutu air"; "ikan dither" should be explained, e.g. "ikan dither (ikan pengalih/penenang)".

Item 11: 'sister group' relationship is described as 'weakly-supported' but the Indonesian puts 'dengan dukungan yang lemah' at the end, which is fine; however 'Crenicichla and Teleocichla ... added' is OK. The real problem: 'Kullander ... Cichlidae divided into six subfamilies' is fine, but 'serangkaian garis keturunan (rumpun)' for 'lineages' is unnatural; use 'linyah/garis keturunan' consisten…

Item 11: 'Hobbyists tend to label these ...' is fine, but 'Masih harus dilihat apakah ketiganya satu spesies' is stiff; use 'Belum diketahui apakah ketiganya merupakan spesies yang sama dengan A. alacrina'.
Item 11: 'klad (clade)' and 'klad crenicarine' are non-standard; use 'klade' and keep the English term in brackets consistently.

Item 1/11: 'Cichlid kerdil bintik merah' is a non-standard rendering of 'redspot dwarf cichlid'; the common Indonesian hobby term is 'cichlid kerdil' with the English trade name, so keep the English name more prominent.
Item 7: 'jentik/larva chironomid (cacing darah)' is clumsy; use 'larva Chironomidae (cacing darah / bloodworm)'. 'kutu air (Daphnia)' is fine but 'jentik' means mosquito larvae and may mislead.
Item 3: 'perairan mati (backwater)' is a loose rendering; 'backwater' is better rendered as 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai'. 'genangan atau kolam kecil' adds 'atau' ambiguity for 'pool'.
Item 5: 'daun beech, oak' leaves untranslated names; use 'daun beech (Fagus), ek/oak'. 'burayak' for fry is acceptable but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
Item 10: 'hyper-aggressive' is softened to 'sangat agresif'; use 'sangat agresif/hiperagresif'. 'pemijah substrat' is fine.
Item 11: 'the putative subfamily Geophaginae' is rendered 'subfamili yang diduga, Geophaginae' – awkward and unclear; rephrase e.g. 'subfamili Geophaginae (yang diusulkan)'.

Item 11: 'Hobbyists ... in order to avoid mixing them and the potential of hybridisation' is OK, but 'Daftar semacam ini terus bertambah ... dan hampir selalu berubah' loses 'augmented by fish' nuance; say 'diperluas dengan ikan-ikan yang muncul di perdagangan'.

Item 11: 'sister to Crenicichla' translated 'kerabat terdekat (sister)' – fine, but 'lineage', 'sublineage', 'klad' left in English/loanwords; use 'garis keturunan/rumpun' and 'klad (clade)' consistently.

Item 3: 'parit/kali kecil' for 'creeks' – 'parit' means ditch/drain, which is wrong; use 'anak sungai kecil'. 'Kubangan' (wallow) for 'roadside pool' is also odd; use 'genangan/kolam kecil di tepi jalan'.
Item 8: ''dither' fishes ... 'ikan kecil sebagai dither fish'' – awkward; use 'ikan kecil penenang (dither fish)'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'chironomid larvae' left as 'larva chironomid'; more natural 'jentik/larva chironomid'. 'Kurang rewel' fine.

Item 1/2: 'Redspot dwarf cichlid' and 'Amazon' left untranslated; use 'Amazon' basin consistently, e.g. 'cichlid kerdil bintik merah'. Item 2: 'bertetangga' for 'neighbouring' is awkward; use 'yang berbatasan'; 'affluent' = 'anak sungai' ok.
Item 4: 'Base dimensions ... acceptable for a single pair' translated 'sudah cukup' ok; 'lembah Amazon' for 'Amazon basin' should be 'cekungan/DAS Amazon'.
Item 11: 'gurat sisi (linea lateralis) ... perkembangannya bervariasi dan sering kali tidak sempurna' word order muddles which is rudimentary; rephrase.
"Sunset-Apistogramma" kept in quotes with hyphen; fine but could be written "Apistogramma Sunset" as hobbyists do.
"dideskripsikan secara ilmiah" is slightly awkward; "dideskripsikan secara resmi" or "sebelum dideskripsikan" is more natural.
Item 11: the English says Farias et al. (1999, 2000, 2001), but the reference list has no 2000 entry. That is a source issue, not a translation error. Nothing to fix here.
Item 8: 'It can be maintained in pairs or groups...' is rendered 'Spesies ini bisa dipelihara berpasangan...'. This is acceptable.
Item 8: the English says the females' spars are 'particularly violent'. The Indonesian 'terutama pada betina yang pertarungannya sangat ganas' keeps this. Fine.
Item 11: 'Geophaginae, sebuah subfamili yang diusulkan' is placed awkwardly. Say 'subfamili yang diusulkan, Geophaginae' or 'putative' as 'yang dianggap/diduga'.
Item 11: 'Teleocichla sudah mapan diketahui sebagai kelompok saudara Crenicichla' is awkward. Use 'sudah diketahui dengan baik sebagai kelompok saudara Crenicichla'.
Item 11: 'sedang dalam warna kawin' for 'nuptial' is slightly loose. Prefer 'individu yang sedang berbiak/berwarna kawin'.
Item 11: 'tempat A. baenschi bernaung' is informal for a technical text. Use 'yang menaungi A. baenschi' or 'yang mencakup A. baenschi'.
Item 11: 'Kullander (1998)' tribe names are given as 'tribus'. 'Tribe' is acceptable, but 'tribus' is not widely used by hobbyists. Optionally use 'tribe'.
Item 11: 'in a state of near-constant flux' is rendered 'hampir selalu berubah'. This is acceptable.
Item 5: 'biologically-immature aquaria' is rendered '(belum cycling)'. This is fine.

Item 8: "betina justru sangat ganas" – English says the fighting among females is particularly violent; "justru" adds a contrast not in the source. Use "terutama pada betina yang sangat ganas" or similar.
Item 5: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – ok-ish, but "biologically-immature" is better as "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".

Item 11: "Para peneliti juga telah mengelompokkan" – English says "authors"; fine, but "Kesimpulan ... hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is fine. Item 1/10: "larviphorous" left untranslated and unexplained; use an Indonesian description (induk membawa burayak di mulut) or put the English term in brackets.

Item 3: "Spesies ikan yang hidup bersamanya" for "sympatric" is acceptable, but "kerabat segenusnya" is awkward; use "sesama anggota genus (A. agassizii)".

Item 5: "Ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar" - 'very large water changes' fine, but 'lightly-stocked' -> 'tidak padat ikan' acceptable.

Item 1: "angka ini pasti merujuk" — English says "must refer" (inference); "pasti" overstates certainty. Use "tentunya/kemungkinan besar merujuk" or "seharusnya merujuk".

Item 6: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but ambiguous; "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)" is clearer for hobbyists.

Item 11: "burayak" for fry is a regional/Javanese-leaning term; "anakan" or "larva/benih" is more common among hobbyists.
Item 4: "sumur di dataran rendah" is literal for "lowland wells"; fine, but "tumbuhan di permukaan" could be "tanaman permukaan".

"Parameter air" for "water values" is fine, but "praktis tidak berpengaruh" could be "praktis tidak berperan".

Item 3: "punya sifat yang cocok" is awkward for "suitably mannered"; use "bersifat tenang/cocok sebagai teman".

Item 1: 'Temperature: 2–30°C' kept as in source; fine. But item 6 'Tanpa itu, kemungkinan besar kesuburannya menurun' ok.

Item 2: "Sekitar separuhnya terancam musnah akibat Gambusia holbrooki atau Fundulus heteroclitus" is OK, but "5-7000 ha" is kept as in the source and is ambiguous. Write "5.000–7.000 ha".

Item 4: Volume "108 liter" is correct, but check "Sepasang atau satu trio" - fine. Item 1: "Baetican toothcarp" left in English with no Indonesian gloss; add an explanation or accepted trade name.

Item 1/6: temperature "2–30 °C" matches the source, but the source's "2–30°C" is likely a typo for 20-30; consider flagging it rather than copying.

Item 8: 'status konservasinya yang jelas rawan' – 'rawan' corresponds to Vulnerable in IUCN Indonesian usage; the source says precarious, so use 'genting/mengkhawatirkan' to avoid implying a category.

Item 11: 'memutuskan untuk menekan nama itu dan memakai Aphanius baru pada tahun 2003' – 'baru' wrongly reads as 'new Aphanius'; the source says 'as recently as 2003'. Rephrase: 'baru pada tahun 2003 ... memutuskan menekan nama Lebias demi Aphanius'.
Item 11: 'Ikan ini kecil kemungkinannya dijual di toko ikan hias' is awkward; use 'Ikan ini jarang dijual di toko ikan hias'.

Item 9: 'garis-garis kasar ke arah pangkal ekor' – 'bars' means vertical bands (pita/palang), not lines; use 'pita vertikal'. Also 'perbedaan jantan dan betina sangat jelas' for sexual dimorphism: use 'dimorfisme seksual'.
Item 4: the 'Volume: ~108 liter' kept correct; no issue. Item 5: 'Begitu pula, substrat tidak wajib' drops the sense 'no need to add a substrate' only slightly; acceptable.
"setiap ekor butuh tempat sembunyi": sebaiknya "setiap ikan" agar lebih natural.
"memanjakan mata pemiliknya": sedikit bebas untuk "delight the aquarist"; bisa "menyenangkan para penghobi".

"penangkap ikan hias": lebih lazim "penangkap ikan hias" atau "pengumpul ikan hias"; "tidak diimpor" sebaiknya "kemungkinan besar tidak diimpor" (sudah benar), pertimbangkan "daerah aliran Sungai Essequibo" tetap OK.

"Ikan ini pertama kali diimpor dari Kolombia, dan saat itu hanya beberapa ekor" - the English says it was imported for the first time in a few specimens; this is acceptable, but the sentence order shifts the emphasis slightly. Consider "pertama kali diimpor dari Kolombia dalam jumlah sedikit".
"panjang standar" - consider adding the hobby term "(standard length)" or phrasing it as "panjang standar (SL), tanpa sirip ekor" for clarity.
"Ikan ini damai" - more natural as "Ikan ini berperangai damai" or "Ikan ini tidak agresif".
"partikel makanan dari dasar" - "dasar" is fine, but "dasar akuarium/substrat" would be clearer.

Item 6: "saat ikan terangsang atau terganggu" adds "atau terganggu" (not in the source, which says only "excited"). Also "bisa menembus sepatu kets" is an added claim. The source says only that a shoe "offers little protection". Remove the added claim and stay close to the source.

Item 5: "tergolong sering dijumpai hingga sangat melimpah" is clumsy for "common to abundant". Use "umum hingga melimpah".

Item 1: 'Commonly captured from catwalks, bridges and piers' was translated as 'sering tertangkap pancing dari ...'. 'pancing' (angling) is added and not in the source. Also 'passes' became 'selat-selat sempit', which is not accurate. Use 'alur/celah perairan' or similar.

Item 2: 'Massachusetts ... to southern Florida in USA and Mexico' is acceptable, but 'Teluk Meksiko bagian utara sampai Florida selatan' reads as if the range starts at Massachusetts and the Gulf. Make the geography clearer.

Item 4: 'continental waters' was translated as 'perairan paparan benua'. This changes the meaning, because the source says continental, not continental shelf. Use 'perairan benua' or 'perairan pesisir benua'.
Item 5: 'umumnya umum sampai melimpah' is clumsy. Use 'umumnya tergolong sering dijumpai hingga sangat melimpah'.

Item 6: 'when the fish is excited' became 'gelisah' (restless), which is not the same as excited or agitated. Use 'terangsang/terganggu'. The sentence about shoes is also missing the point that the spine can puncture them, so the meaning of 'offers little protection' is partly lost.

Item 8: 'manuscript name' became 'nama dari naskah', which is awkward. Use 'nama manuskrip'. 'catfish/ikan berkumis' is acceptable, but 'bycatch in trawl and saltwater angler catches' is rendered as 'pukat', which is not trawl. Use 'pukat tarik/trawl'. 'Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)' is acceptable, but 'Risiko Rendah' is not the standard Indonesian term. Use 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Kekhawatiran Ren…
Item 7: 'Belum dilaporkan' with 'pemijahan' is acceptable, but 'breeding' is more general than 'spawning'. Use 'pembiakan'.
Item 1: "sebagian besar hidupnya di air payau" has no verb and reads clumsily; use "menghabiskan sebagian besar hidupnya di air payau".
Item 1: "padahal bisa tumbuh" adds a contrast the English doesn't have; use "tetapi" or "namun".

Item 7: "kerang, kerang kecil/remis" for "mussel, cockle" is confusing, and "ikan lancefish (sand eel)" leaves English in place. Use a clear local term (e.g. "kerang hijau, kerang darah") and a translation for lancefish.
Item 10: "memungut bintik itu ke dalam mulutnya bersama telur-telurnya" mistranslates "add them to the brood". Say the female tries to pick up the egg spots as if they were eggs.

Item 10: "agar agresi jantan tersebar ke beberapa betina" is fine, but "telur/anaknya" for "brood" and "agar induk tidak memakan anaknya" garble the advice. EN says to avoid fry predation, and the second phrase reads as if moving prevents eating.

Item 10: "Jantan akan membersihkan lokasi pemijahan... memamerkan diri" is OK. But "anakan secara manual" for "artificially strip" is vague; say the fry are "diambil/dikeluarkan secara paksa" from the mouth.
Item 10: "peternak" for breeders is odd in the hobby. Use "pembiak" or "breeder".
Item 9: "jantan yang sedang dalam masa kawin" is acceptable, but "intensifies greatly" is reduced to "makin kuat"; "sangat" is missing.

Item 10: 'Burayak sudah cukup besar untuk menerima naupli artemia sejak awal' is fine. However, 'artemia' should keep the genus style 'Artemia' or 'naupli Artemia' because it is a Latin name.
Item 11: 'up to around 4" long' was converted to 'sekitar 10 cm', which is correct. 'efisien' for 'efficient ambush predator' is fine.

Item 9: 'jantan yang sedang dalam masa kawin' and 'siap memijah' are fine. 'Garis gelap di tubuh juga menghilang' is fine.

Item 10: "punggung tajam" and "punggung yang jelas" for 'ridges' is a literal mistranslation. Use "rigi/gerigi tajam" or "tonjolan memanjang".
Item 10: "kerabat segenusnya" for 'congeners' is awkward. Use "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama".
Items 1, 3, 10: "lele" for sisorid catfish is imprecise. Use "ikan lele sisorid" or "catfish".
Item 10: "fasilitas" and "penghobi pribadi" are fine, but "tuberkel" and "takson" are stiff. Consider "tonjolan (tuberkel)".
Item 11: The reference list is untranslated, which is correct. No fix needed.

Item 1: "punggung tulang yang tajam" for "sharp ridges" is wrong (reads as backbone/spine); use "rigi tajam" or "tonjolan memanjang yang tajam". Same in item 10: "satu punggung tulang tajam", "sepasang punggung tulang memanjang", and "punggung atau tonjolan besar" (ridges). Change these to "rigi" or "lunas".
Item 1: "Tengkorak yang terbuka dan kasar berkerut" is awkward. Use "tengkorak (cranium) yang terekspos dan berkerut kasar".

Item 10: "permukaan atas tengkorak bertulang dan pelat predorsal yang kasar berkerut dan terbuka" misreads the structure. Rewrite it as "permukaan dorsal tengkorak bertulang yang berkerut kasar, dan pelat predorsal terbuka (tidak tertutup kulit)".
Item 10: "pangkal awal sirip adiposa" is redundant. Use "pangkal sirip adiposa" for "adipose fin origin".

Item 10: "subfamili Sisoridae yang diduga (putative)" is wrong. Sisoridae is a family and the source calls it a "putative subfamily". Fix the rank and wording, e.g. "yang diduga sebagai subfamili Sisoridae".

Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup (feeder)" is slightly off, since feeder fish are pakan, not bait. Use "ikan pakan (feeder fish)". Also, "ikan mas koki" should be "ikan mas koki" or "goldfish" with consistent terms.
Item 7: "ikan livebearer" is acceptable, but "cenderung tidak bernilai gizi tinggi" is clumsy. Use "cenderung bernilai gizi rendah".
Item 1: "lele sisorid" and "Crocodile catfish" are left as raw English. Use "lele buaya (crocodile catfish)" for the common name.
Item 2: "isthmus" is left in English; use the Indonesian anatomical term "istmus" (optionally with the English in brackets).

Item 6: "Volumenya sekitar 243 liter" – the English gives 243 L (64 US gal), so the litre figure is fine; but 120×45 cm base alone cannot give 243 L, which is a source issue, not a translator one. No fix needed there.

Item 12: "Sesama ikan, terutama jantan, jarang saling menoleransi" – this is a mistranslation. The English says males in particular rarely tolerate each other. Write "terutama jantan, jarang saling menoleransi" and drop "Sesama ikan", or write "Para jantan khususnya jarang saling menoleransi".

Item 12: "jarang saling menoleransi kecuali di akuarium yang sangat besar" – keep the meaning of the English "will not often tolerate each other in all but the largest aquaria". It is fine as is, but "3 betina atau lebih" is correct.

Item 9: "Komposisi kimia air tidak terlalu penting" – the English says "meaningless". It weakens the claim a little, but it is acceptable. Check consistency with item 8, which gives pH 5.5–7.0 and 1–15 dGH.
Item 3: "Palembang" is used in the translation but "Palambang" is in the source. This is a correct fix. "Lematang" is also correct.
Item 13: "betina yang lebih banyak" – "an excess of females" means more females than males. This is OK, but "beberapa betina" would be more natural.
Item 7: "Heater" is a hobby term that is acceptable. "pemanas" is the more common alternative, so consider "pemanas (heater)".
Item 17: "batang ekornya kurang tinggi" – "less deep caudal peduncle" is better as "batang ekor lebih ramping/rendah".
Item 9: "Komposisi kimia air tidak berpengaruh" is an overly absolute rendering of "meaningless" and contradicts the pH/dGH ranges given elsewhere; soften it, e.g. "tidak terlalu penting".

Item 3: the EN says "Lamatang" and "Palambang". The ID silently changes them to "Lematang" and "Palembang". The corrected names are fine, but keep the Latin species spelling consistent: the EN "majusuculus" was changed to "majusculus".
Item 1: "Lele" for a bagrid is acceptable, but "Ukuran maksimalnya sekitar 20 cm" should say panjang maksimal (maximum length).
Item 12: "3 betina atau lebih" is correct, but "Khususnya sesama jantan jarang bisa saling menerima" is awkward. Rephrase as "terutama jantan, jarang saling menoleransi".

Item 6: the volume "243 liter" is fine, but the source's 48 × 18 in and 64 US gal were dropped, as instructed. No fix needed except to check the 243 L figure. 120×45 cm with a height of about 45 cm gives about 243 L, so it is OK.
Item 13: "Saat waktu makan" is redundant. Use "Saat waktu makan" → "Pada waktu makan".
"lele-lele besar": Bagrus is a bagrid, not a true lele (Clariidae); better use "ikan lele bagrid" or "catfish Bagrus" to avoid implying Clarias-type catfish.
"pengecualian yang menarik dari hal ini": more natural as "pengecualian yang menarik dari aturan ini" (English says 'this rule').
"identifikasi spesiesnya cukup sulit": fine, but "sesama jenis" for 'conspecifics' could be clearer as "sesama spesiesnya".
Item 4: 120 × 45 cm base 'about 243 litres' is kept unchanged. This is fine, but the source gives no height, so check that the translation adds none.
Item 10: 'tidak menjaga anaknya' is acceptable, but 'burayak' is a less common term than 'anakan' or 'larva' among Indonesian hobbyists. Consider 'anakan ikan (fry)'.
Item 10: 'Telur akan menetas dalam 24–48 jam' is fine. 'ber-pH sedikit asam hingga netral' is slightly awkward. Consider 'pH sedikit asam hingga netral'.
Item 10: 'air matang' for 'mature water' is misleading. In Indonesian, 'air matang' means boiled water. Use 'air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)' or 'air dari akuarium yang sudah berjalan'.
Item 10: 'Beri pakan seukuran infusoria' is understandable but terse. 'Pakan sekecil infusoria' reads more naturally.
Item 5: 'Arus deras seperti air bah' translates 'torrent-like' too dramatically. 'Air bah' means flood. Use 'arus deras seperti aliran torrent/jeram'.
Item 5: 'aquascape dibuat menyerupai' is awkward. Use 'akuarium ditata (aquascape) menyerupai sungai berarus'.

Item 1: 'sehingga ... tercatat dengan nama tersebut' is understandable. The ichthyological 'extirpated' is rendered 'punah', which wrongly implies global extinction. Use 'punah secara lokal / tidak lagi ditemukan di sana' (also items 1 and 2).
Item 10: "kayu beech (Fagus)" adds a Latin genus name that the English doesn't have. Remove "(Fagus)" or keep it consistent with the other items.
Item 18: "angelfish" is translated as "manfish", which is wrong. Use "angelfish" or "ikan manfish/bidadari". "manfish" is not the standard term.
Item 18: "monos and scats" is left as "monos dan scat". Use "monodaktilus (mono) dan skat", or add Indonesian names.
Item 18: "Endler's livebearers" became just "endler". Write "guppy endler".

Item 13: "Salinitas: mereka tidak tahan, bahkan di air payau sekalipun" changes the meaning. The English says they do not tolerate even brackish water, so write "tidak tahan salinitas, bahkan air payau pun".

Item 3: "rentan (vulnerable) dan terancam" keeps the English claim, but check it against the IUCN status. Also "temperature-acclimate" is rendered as "aklimatisasi suhu", which is acceptable but could be clearer.
Item 10: "kayu beech atau ek" uses a mix of English and Indonesian. "Beech" should be "kayu bukit/beech" with a gloss. "Substrat pasir yang lembut" would read better as "pasir halus".
Item 9: "ikan yang rewel" (demanding fish) is slightly off. Use "ikan yang menuntut perawatan khusus".

Items 2 and 9: the minimum tank size is 40 L, but item 8 says 45 × 20 cm (about 18 L) is preferable. This is a source inconsistency, so check that the translation reflects both statements consistently.
Item 7: "sungai kecil dan sungai dangkal" is redundant and awkward. Use "anak sungai dan sungai dangkal".
Item 21: "1,5±0,5 mm" is fine, but "Dwarf Ember Barb biasanya tidak dipijahkan" should say "jarang dipijahkan" for naturalness.
"paling pas dibandingkan dengan ikan trout" is awkward; use "paling tepat dibandingkan dengan" or "paling cocok disamakan dengan".
"Bukaan mulut Barilius tergolong besar" is stiff; use "Mulut Barilius tergolong lebar" or "Celah mulut ...".
"menyelam ke dasar" for "dive into the ground" is unclear; use "membenamkan diri ke dasar" or "masuk ke dalam substrat".
"warna sirip ekornya lain" is colloquial; use "berbeda".
"Pola warna" for "coloration" is slightly off; "warna tubuh" or "corak warna" is more natural.
"tampak sangat berwarna" is awkward; use "sangat berwarna-warni".
Item 7: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine in meaning, but "sudah matang secara biologis" or "belum cycling" is more common among hobbyists.
Item 12: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise. Use "saat penuh telur" or "saat bertelur/matang gonad".
Item 14: "Penempatan genus spesies Barilius" is slightly awkward. Use "Penempatan genus spesies-spesies Barilius".
Item 10: "sangat suka bertengkar" is a bit clumsy. Use "sangat agresif/suka berkelahi".
Item 11: "berenang serempak (schooling)" is a bit awkward. Use "berkelompok rapat" for schooling.
Item 14: "tuberkel" for "tubercules" in item 12 is acceptable, but "bintil kawin" is more common in Indonesian.
Item 4: "Volume: ~648 liter" is wrong for a 180 × 60 cm base. The English figure is kept, so the number is not wrong as translated. It is a source-consistency matter, so leave it as is.
Item 8: "ikan yang lebih lemah" for "subdominant fish" is a bit loose. Use "ikan subdominan" or "ikan dengan peringkat lebih rendah".

Item 8: "ikan shoaling (berkelompok longgar), bukan schooling (berenang serempak dalam formasi)" is fine. But "Teman setangki" should be "tankmate/ikan penghuni bersama". "Setangki" is acceptable but non-standard for aquariums; prefer "teman satu akuarium".
Item 1: "Sesekali dijual" is fine. But "Butuh akuarium yang sangat besar dan sudah benar-benar matang" is too informal for a handbook. Use "Memerlukan".
Item 7: "gut-loaded" is rendered as "sudah diberi pakan bergizi". This loses the specific meaning. Use "diberi pakan bergizi tinggi (gut-loading) sebelum diberikan".
Item 7: "merumput" for "graze" is odd for fish. Use "mengerik/memakan lapisan alga".
Item 7: "kutu air (daphniid)" is correct for daphnia, but daphniid and copepod are different taxa. Keep "copepoda" and write "daphnia" consistently.
Item 3: "batu kali/kerakal" for "cobbles" is a slash alternative that leaves the term ambiguous. Pick one term, such as "batu kerakal".
Item 5: "biologically-immature aquaria" rendered as "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – adds a specific claim; better "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis".
Item 9: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" – gravid means full of eggs, not laying; use "saat penuh telur / bunting telur".
Item 7: "gut-loaded" translated as "sudah diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" – unclear; say the insects were fed nutritious food beforehand ("diberi pakan bergizi sebelum diberikan ke ikan").
Item 4: "luas permukaan minimal 180 × 60 cm" fine, but "~648 liter" unchanged OK; no issue. Item 5: "batu ... yang halus terkikis air" for "water-worn" – better "batu bulat yang terkikis arus".
Item 1: "Sesekali dijual" fine; "makannya rakus" ok. Item 3: "batu bulat" for "cobbles" – better "batu kali/kerakal".
Item 8: "Ikan yang jauh lebih kecil juga sebaiknya tidak dicampur" ok; "lele loricariid" – loricariids are not lele; use "ikan loricariid (sapu-sapu)" instead of "lele".
Item 8: "sedangkan ikan yang dipelihara sendirian bisa menjadi agresif" ok; but "spesies shoaling ... bukan schooling" explanations fine.
Item 11: "Penempatan genus spesies Barilius" – awkward; "penempatan genus spesies-spesies Barilius".

Item 4: "Volume: sekitar 540 liter" matches the English, so no fix is needed there. In item 5, "biologically-immature aquaria" became "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang". This adds a specific meaning, so use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" or "belum matang" as in item 1.
Item 5: "Anubias spp. bisa ditanam dengan diikatkan pada dekorasi" is awkward. Use "bisa ditempelkan pada dekorasi".
Item 5: "Kalau mau" and "tapi" are too colloquial for a handbook. Use "jika diinginkan" and "tetapi".
Item 8: "jam makan" and "makannya lahap" are a little casual. "Teman setangki" is less standard than "tankmate" or "ikan penghuni bersama".
Item 8: "Ikan yang jauh lebih kecil ... tidak dicampur" is acceptable, but "Much smaller fishes should also be omitted" is more neutral. No change is required.

Item 11: "Rainboth (1991) memasukkan anggota 'group ii' versi Howes". Howe's is a possessive, so "versi Howes" is fine. In "the following combination of characters", the Indonesian "tapis insang ramping dan jelas bentuknya" is weak for "well-defined". Use "tapis insang ramping dan terdefinisi jelas".
Item 7: "sudah diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" is imprecise. Use "sudah diberi pakan bernutrisi tinggi sebelumnya (gut-loading)".
Item 3: "batu kali" for "cobbles" is acceptable, but "batu bulat" or "kerakal" is more precise. "Menghuni" as the opening verb is a little formal.
Item 4: 'luas permukaan minimal 150 × 60 cm' is fine, but the volume '540 litres' is kept; OK. No issue.
Item 5: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically-immature aquaria' is okay, but 'Butuh... akuarium yang sudah matang' in item 1 is fine; no change.
Item 5: 'pelompat yang hebat' is weak for 'prodigious jumpers'; use 'pelompat ulung' or 'sangat suka melompat'.
Item 5: 'sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' is misleading, since gravid means full of eggs and not yet laying; use 'saat sedang penuh telur/bunting telur'.
Item 8: 'rakus saat makan' for 'vigorous feeder' adds a negative nuance; use 'makan dengan agresif/lahap'.
Item 9: 'Jantan yang siap kawin ... tuberkel' is acceptable, but 'sedang bertelur' above should be fixed.
Item 11: 'Howe's group ii' is rendered 'versi Howes', which is fine; 'gain wider usage' is OK. 'sebagai subdivisi ... di dalam Barilius' is fine.
Item 8: 'Ikan yang jauh lebih kecil juga sebaiknya tidak dicampur' is fine; but 'shoaling rather than schooling' glosses are okay.
Item 10: 'ganti air ... memakai air yang lebih dingin' fine; 'burayak' is rare for hobbyists, so prefer 'anakan' or 'benih'.
Item 4: "pers. comm." left in English; use "komunikasi pribadi" (or "kom. pribadi").
Item 12: "not gain wider usage until Kottelat (2013)" is rendered "baru dipakai lebih luas sejak", which is fine, but "Howe's" is rendered "dari Howes". Keep this consistent.
Item 6: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is a bit indirect for "biologically-immature aquaria". Use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 9: "Teman setangki" is odd; use "penghuni lain/tankmate yang cocok". "Rakus saat makan" slightly overstates "vigorous feeder"; use "agresif/lincah saat makan".
Item 8: "diberi pakan bergizi (gut-loading)" is vague; say "diberi makanan bergizi tinggi terlebih dahulu".
Item 1: "dipelihara berkelompok, dan akuarium yang sudah matang" – the parallel list is awkward; better "butuh akuarium yang sangat besar dan sudah matang, serta harus dipelihara berkelompok".
Item 6: "sungai atau aliran air" is vague for "flowing stream or river"; use "sungai kecil (anak sungai) atau sungai berarus".
Item 6: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – use the common hobby term "akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 6: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders"; use "batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus".
Item 3: "diduga endemik dan tersebar" – clearer as "diduga endemik dan ditemukan di seluruh ..."; "Catatannya berasal dari" is stiff.
Item 9: "mengalahkan" for "outcompete" is imprecise; use "menyaingi" or "kalah bersaing mendapat makanan".
Item 9: "hidup bergerombol longgar (shoaling)... berenang serempak (schooling)" is wordy; the explanation was added in the translation.
Item 2/4: "Ghats Barat" – the usual form is "Ghat Barat" (Western Ghats).
Item 8: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" – "gut-loading" is better explained as "diberi pakan bergizi lebih dahulu".
Item 1: "Akuarium wajib ditutup rapat" – the source says "needs a tight-fitting lid". Better: "Perlu tutup yang pas/rapat". The meaning is intact.
Item 5: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – "biologically-immature" is more natural as "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 5: "Tutup yang rapat juga mutlak perlu" is clumsy. Use "juga sangat penting".
Item 5: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders". Use "batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus".
Item 8: "mengalahkan" for "outcompete" is weak. Use "menyingkirkan dalam perebutan pakan".
Item 8: "makannya rakus" and "teman setangki" are slightly informal. "Penghuni akuarium lain" is more standard.
Item 9: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise. Use "saat membawa telur / bunting telur".
Item 7: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" is vague. Say "diberi pakan bergizi tinggi sebelum dijadikan pakan".
Item 2: "kalau memang begitu" is colloquial in a handbook. Use "jika demikian".
Item 9: "gravid" is rendered as "saat sedang bertelur", which means laying eggs. Use "saat penuh telur" or "sedang membawa telur".
Item 3: "zona asuhan" is a stiff calque of "nursery zones". Use something like "area pembesaran anakan".
Item 7: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" is vague. Say the live feed was fed nutritious food beforehand, e.g. "sudah diberi pakan bergizi sebelumnya (gut-loading)".
Item 1: "Akuarium wajib memakai tutup" adds "Akuarium" and is slightly stronger than the source; "Needs a tight-fitting lid" is fine as plain "Perlu tutup yang rapat".
Item 5: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is wordy; use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 5: "batu ... yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders"; use "bongkahan batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus" or "batu sungai yang membulat".
Item 7: "di-gut-load (diberi makan bergizi)" leaves English in place and the gloss is imprecise; use "diberi pakan bergizi terlebih dahulu (gut-loading)".
Item 8: "berenang serempak (schooling)" is slightly off; use "berenang rapat dan serempak".
Item 8: "lele loricariid" is not accurate, because loricariids are not true lele; use "ikan lele loricariid (sapu-sapu)" or just "loricariid".
Item 11: "memasukkan anggota 'group ii' ... ke dalam nama genus Opsarius yang divalidasi ulang" is awkward; use "menempatkan ... ke dalam genus Opsarius yang divalidasi kembali".
Item 11: "nomor L L239" has a doubled "L"; write "nomor L (L-number) L239" or "kode L239".

Item 7: "occasional defrosted prawn or shrimp" is rendered only as "udang yang sudah dicairkan"; this is fine, but "hasil laut bercangkang (udang, kerang)" for "shellfish" adds "udang" and "kerang" examples that are not in the source. Use "kerang-kerangan/krustasea".
Item 5: "Penataan" and "Tatanan" are used loosely for "set-up". Use one consistent term such as "aquascape/tata letak".
Item 1/8: "sensitif" for "somewhat delicate" is acceptable, but "rapuh/mudah stres" would be more precise for care advice.
Item 11: "zirah/berzirah bermulut pengisap" is a coined gloss and "lempeng tubuh midventral" is left half-untranslated. Use "lempeng tulang" and "bagian tengah perut (midventral)".
Item 3: "Seri tipe (spesimen acuan)" is acceptable, but "seri tipe" is better rendered "spesimen tipe".
Item 1: "Sungai Orinoco dan hilir río Guaviare" adds "Sungai" to Orinoco, while Guaviare keeps the "río" form. Make this consistent, e.g. "Sungai Orinoco dan hilir Sungai Guaviare".
Item 1 and item 8: "agak rentan" for "somewhat delicate" can be misread as susceptible to disease. Use "agak sensitif" or "agak sulit dipelihara" for the intended sense.
Item 5: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders". Use "bongkahan batu besar yang terkikis/halus oleh aliran air".
Item 5: "aufwuchs (lapisan biofilm dan alga)" is an added gloss. It is acceptable, but use one consistent term for aufwuchs across the text.
Item 7: "kerang-kerangan/udang" for "shellfish" mixes terms. Use "hasil laut bercangkang (udang, kerang)".
Item 7: "pakan ikan" for "puréed fish food" is ambiguous. "Daging ikan" or "pakan ikan yang dihaluskan" is clearer.
Item 7: "mampu menghirup udara atmosfer" is slightly stiff. "Mampu bernapas dengan udara bebas" would be more natural.
Item 3: "dasar batuan granit" for "granite bedrock" is awkward. Use "batuan dasar granit".
Item 11: "Cakram pengisap yang dibentuk oleh bagian mulut dimiliki oleh semua anggotanya" is clumsy. Rephrase it more naturally.
Item 5: "digerogoti ikan" for "graze" sounds like gnawing or eating away. Use "dirumput" or "dimakan dengan cara merumput".
Item 11: "nama dagang alternatif" for "alternative vernacular name" is slightly off. "Nama umum alternatif" is closer.
Item 5: "bongkahan batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is a little awkward. "Batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus" reads more naturally.
Item 6: 'Aquarium base: 120 × 45 cm' is fine, but the volume '~243 liter' is kept while the US gal figure was dropped, which is OK. No fault there, so ignore it.

Item 12: 'quite little shy' (agak kurang pemalu) is translated as 'tidak terlalu pemalu'. This is acceptable, but the item 7/12 'sudah bisa dipelihara di akuarium 100 cm' conflicts with item 6, which says the minimum is 120 × 45 cm. This is a source inconsistency, so flag it or keep the wording faithful.
Item 15: 'sympatrically' is translated as 'hidup simpatrik'. This is hard for hobbyists. Use 'hidup berdampingan di habitat yang sama'.
Item 8: 'yang akan dirumput oleh ikan' is awkward. Use 'yang menjadi tempat ikan merumput' or 'yang dimakan ikan dengan cara dikerik'.
Item 8: 'batu bulat yang terkikis arus' (water-worn boulders) is slightly awkward. Use 'bongkahan batu yang terkikis air'.
Item 15: 'Famili ... terbesar di antara ikan lele' is fine, but 'lele berzirah bermulut penghisap' is unnatural. Use 'lele berbaju zirah bermulut pengisap', or keep 'suckermouth armoured catfish'.
Item 11: 'karasin' for characids is not a term hobbyists commonly use. Use 'characid' or 'ikan characin'.
Item 10: 'mixed brown orgamic' was translated as 'organik' and the typo was silently fixed. This is minor.

Item 6: 'Panjang standar: 151 mm SL' — the English also gives '6 in SL'. Converting inches to cm is fine, but 151 mm is already metric. Keep it as is; the real problem is the volume, so check that '~243 liter' matches the source (it does) and say 'SL' once as 'panjang standar (SL)'.
Item 12: 'cukup tidak pemalu' is awkward and unnatural. Use 'tidak terlalu pemalu' or 'cukup berani'.

Item 10: 'mixed brown orgamic' in the source is a typo for 'organic'. The translation 'campuran bahan organik dan mineral berwarna cokelat' moves 'cokelat' onto the materials and drops the 'matrix' (matriks) sense. Use 'matriks organik dan mineral campuran berwarna cokelat'.
Item 11: 'sangat cocok' is stronger than the English 'particularly suitable' and is acceptable, but 'ruang teritori' is awkward. Use 'ruang wilayah' or 'wilayah teritorial yang cukup'.

Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is more commonly 'kutu air (Daphnia)'; 'siap kawin' should be 'siap memijah' for fish.

Item 8: 'Ikan jantan ... bersaing satu sama lain untuk menarik perhatian betina' is fine; 'teman satu akuarium' is awkward, use 'penghuni lain'. 'tertekan' for 'intimidated' shifts the meaning toward 'stressed'; use 'terintimidasi'.
Item 8: the English says 'among representatives available in the ornamental trade', and the Indonesian restructures; fine. 'gugup' for nervous is odd; use 'tidak mudah takut/stres'.
Item 9: 'bertubuh jelas lebih bulat' is awkward; use 'tampak jelas lebih membulat'.

Item 11: Terms like 'pita' for bars, 'predorsal' and 'interorbital' are left untranslated or are non-standard; use 'garis/belang' for bars and 'panjang predorsal' with explanation. 'SL', 'BL' and 'HL' are not defined.
Item 12: The reference list is left untranslated as the instructions allow; no fix.
Item 6: "Volume: ~81 litres" for a 90 × 30 cm base needs tank height; the translation keeps the source figure, so no fix is required here. Ignore this note.
Item 15: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "Tubifex" in item 11 is also rendered as "cacing sutra". Keep this consistent.
Item 5: "batu kerikil bulat" for pebbles is awkward. Use "kerikil besar" or "batu kali".
Item 5: "Dasarnya didominasi batu besar dan batu kecil" for "rocks and stones" is acceptable but loose. Keep the terms consistent with the earlier substrate wording.
Item 5: "anak sungai" for "stream" and "beberapa anak sungai dan sungai" in item 4 suggest tributaries. Use "sungai kecil" or "aliran sungai".
Item 5: "Kamyit Chaung" is rendered as "Di Kamyit Chaung" while the source says "In the Kamyit Chaung river". Minor, but "sungai Kamyit Chaung" is closer.
Item 1: "Burma" is used in item 1 and "Myanmar" elsewhere, which matches the source. No fix needed. Ignore this note.

Item 7: "Memelihara Garra flavatra sangat mudah." conflicts with the longer care text, which says the fish needs stable, mature, well-oxygenated water. The English says "very easy", so this is faithful, but check whether the source is inconsistent.

Item 9: "Parameter air lainnya tidak berpengaruh baginya" says the other parameters have no effect, which matches the source. However, it conflicts with item 10 (pH 6.5–7.5, 2–12 dGH). Check whether this is intended.
Item 5/17: "Garra sensu stricto" and "klad" are fine. "sebaran" in "memiliki sebaran yang lebih luas" is fine.

Item 4: "Habitat asli ... terletak di bagian barat Papua Nugini" — Lake Sentani is in Indonesian Papua, not Papua New Guinea. The English says this, but the translation should not keep the error (item 2 and 5 say Indonesia/New Guinea). Fix, e.g. "bagian barat Pulau Papua (New Guinea), Indonesia".
Item 2: "Ikan hasil penangkaran massal warnanya jauh lebih pucat" — the English says "far less colour". "Pucat" is acceptable, but "kurang berwarna" is more faithful.
Item 1: "bikin heboh" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "menimbulkan kehebohan". The English also says "storms of enthusiasm", which is lost.
Item 3: "seiring setiap sentimeter pertumbuhan ikan" is awkward. Use "bertambah indah setiap pertambahan panjang satu sentimeter". "Tapi ... pun" is clumsy; use "Namun".
Item 14: "Filter kecil bertenaga aerator" is unclear. Use "filter udara kecil (air-driven)". "burayak" is a less common term than "anakan" among hobbyists.
Item 10: "Pemberian pakan beku dan pakan hidup" is correct, but "Tidak rewel" is slightly informal. Optionally use "Tidak pilih-pilih makanan".
Item 8: "paling cocok tampil" is awkward. Use "tampak paling betah/serasi".
"500 mm SL": "SL" (standard length) is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)" and perhaps cm (50 cm).
"cyprinid": could use "ikan suku Cyprinidae", which is more natural.

"hidup di tempat yang sama" for sympatric is fine, but "biasanya mengalir melewati hutan tropis" is ambiguous: the subject is the river, not the fish. Rephrase as "sungai yang biasanya melewati hutan tropis".
"Terutama ikan sungai": "Predominantly" is better rendered as "Umumnya".
"bimaculata... Sarawak": the "bibiography" typo in the reference list is left as in the source, which is acceptable.
Item 1: "Butuh akuarium dengan panjang minimal 2 m" conflicts with 240 cm base, but it's faithful to the source; fine. Real issue: item 1 says "memutar air akuarium 8–12 kali per jam" – OK.
Item 5: Volume "~864 liter" is correct for 240×60×60; fine.

Item 12: "bercak depannya terletak di bawah separuh belakang sirip punggung" – OK, but "di Kalimantan" placement is awkward: "negara bagian Sarawak, Malaysia, di Kalimantan" should be "negara bagian Sarawak di Pulau Kalimantan, Malaysia".
Item 8: "ikan teri (whitebait)" – whitebait is not teri; use "ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)" or similar.
Item 8: "ikan mas koki kecil" for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but "ikan 'pakan'" should be "ikan umpan/feeder fish".
Item 8: "sebagian ikan kecil" for 'some smaller fish also taken' reads as a portion of fish; better "serta beberapa ikan yang lebih kecil".
Item 9: "ikan yang kalah dominan" for 'subdominant fish' is awkward; use "ikan yang berstatus subdominan".
Item 2/6: "cyprinid ... mudah kaget" for 'skittish' okay; but "Wajib pakai tutup" in item 2 is stronger than the source 'Needs'; use "Perlu".
Item 12: "satu lagi di batang ekor dan dilewati gurat sisi" is awkward passive. Use "dan menyilang/melewati gurat sisi".
Item 9: "ikan yang kalah dominan" is unnatural for "subdominant fish". Use "ikan subdominan" or "ikan yang berada di peringkat bawah".
Item 3: the English says 'H. nebulosa' and the translation writes 'H. nebulosus'. That quietly changes a Latin name, so keep it as in the source or flag it as the name used there.

Item 2: 'negara bagian Kelantan' and 'negara bagian Terengganu' are fine, but 'wilayah Kalimantan bagian Malaysia' is wrong. Kalimantan is the Indonesian part of Borneo, so the Malaysian part should be called 'Borneo bagian Malaysia'. Say 'Borneo' for the island, e.g. 'Borneo bagian Malaysia maupun Indonesia'.

Items 1 and 5: 'menyaring volume akuarium 8–12 kali per jam' and the 10–15 version are acceptable, but 'turning the tank over' is rendered inconsistently with the 'Turnover' wording. Also, item 1 says 'tercatat di Kalimantan' where the English says Borneo, so change it to 'Borneo'.
Item 5: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air' is awkward. Use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat karena terkikis arus'.
Item 5: the English says 'oxygenated' and the translation says 'kaya oksigen'. 'Kaya oksigen' is acceptable, but 'beroksigen baik' is closer to 'well-oxygenated'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but hobbyists commonly write 'daphnia'. 'Ikan dari famili Balitoridae' is fine, though the English 'Balitorids' is more generic.
Item 11: 'Homalopteroides ... sungut rostral' and 'bantalan dagu (mental pad)' are acceptable. 'Genus ... divalidasi ulang' is stiff, so use 'diakui kembali sebagai genus yang sah'.
Item 1: the EN has 8–12 times an hour and Item 5 says 10–15. That is the source's own difference, so it is not a translation error. Nothing to fix.
Item 3: "Di air terjun Air Terjun Sekayu" repeats "air terjun". Use "Di Air Terjun Sekayu".
Item 6: the source says 20–25.5°C and the translation keeps it as 20–25,5 °C. This is fine, so no fix needed.
Item 5: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward. It reads as if the stones are fine. Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air dengan berbagai ukuran".
Item 5: "yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" for "biologically immature set-up" is acceptable but slightly changed. Consider "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis".
Item 5: "air diputar 10–15 kali per jam" is vague. Say that the tank volume is filtered 10–15 times per hour.
Item 3: "H. nebulosa" is kept as in the source, but the species name elsewhere is H. nebulosus. This is a source inconsistency and could be left or harmonised.
Item 8: "lele dari genus Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp." is mixed. Use "lele (catfish) dari genus ..." without "spp." next to "genus".
Item 8: "teman setangki" is non-standard. Use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "tankmate".
Item 20: "very boisterous" is translated as "sangat agresif". Boisterous means rowdy or energetic, not aggressive. Use "sangat lincah/hiperaktif" or "heboh".
Item 27: "After a couple of weeks" is translated as "Setelah beberapa minggu". A couple means about two. Use "sekitar dua minggu".
Item 3: "peternakan" for "breeding facility" sounds like livestock farming; "tempat pembiakan" or "penangkaran/farm ikan" is more natural.
Item 10: "merusak sirip" is slightly flat for "ruffle each other's fins"; "saling menggigit/mencabik sirip" is closer.
Item 19: 'harlequin rasboras (cá tam giác)' – the Vietnamese name was dropped, which is fine, but 'Jack Dempsey' is kept unchanged. This is minor, so no fix is needed there.

Item 16: 'some diatoms' became 'sebagian diatom' and 'some mosquito larvae' became 'sebagian jentik nyamuk'. 'Sebagian' reads as 'a portion of', so use 'beberapa diatom' and 'beberapa jentik nyamuk' to keep the meaning.
Item 9: 'biologically immature aquarium' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable but narrows the meaning. 'Akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis' is closer.

Item 22: 'Aged water can result in high mortality' became 'Air yang sudah lama tidak diganti'. The English says old, stagnant water, so the translation adds the cause 'tidak diganti' and shifts the meaning slightly. Use 'air tua/lama'.
Item 22: 'air-powered sponge filter' became 'filter spons bertenaga aerator'. Use 'filter spons bertenaga udara/aerator', which is fine. 'Jari-jari ... berbentuk filamen' is also fine.
Item 3: 'Populasinya juga dikenal dari Danau Bosset dan Danau Kala' is awkward. Use 'Populasi juga diketahui ada di ...'.

Item 19: 'Siamese algae eater' and 'paradise fish' are left in English, and 'angelfish' became 'manfish'. Use 'sepat siam' or 'SAE', and 'manfish' is acceptable. 'Monos and scat (ikan kiper)' is a poor rendering, since monos should be 'mono (ikan kitiran)'.
Item 19: 'Clown killifish' and 'Panda garra' are left in English. They are trade names, so this is acceptable.
Item 23: 'Hardness (15–17 GH)' matches the source. 'Telolesital' is acceptable. 'Dijantankan' is non-standard, so use 'dimaskulinisasi'.
Item 17: 'ikan pelangi bergerombol' and 'ikan shoaling daripada schooling' leave the English terms in place. Add the local terms 'berkelompok' or 'bergerombol' alongside them.

Item 5: "about 81 litres" for 90 × 30 cm is kept as given; the source figure was likely a US-gallon conversion that depends on tank height. Verify the volume, since a base size alone does not set the litres.
Item 12: "Tidak lazimnya" is awkward for "Unusually". Use "Tidak biasanya" or "Hal yang tidak lazim".
Item 12: "kelompok spesies dugaan" is stiff for "putative species groups". Use "kelompok spesies yang diduga".
Item 13: "ghost glass catfish" is left in English and lowercased, while the English has it capitalised as a name. Add a local form such as "lele kaca" or keep the capitalisation.
Item 1/6/9: "lele silurid" and "Teman setangki" are slightly unnatural. Use "lele dari famili Siluridae" and "teman satu akuarium" ("tangki" is acceptable but "akuarium" is more standard).
Item 9: "yang terlalu aktif dan agresif" adds "agresif" that is not in the English "boisterous". Use "terlalu lincah/heboh".
Item 1: The opening "Ikan kaca (glass catfish)" is not a common Indonesian name. "Lele kaca" is the usual name, so use it.
Item 3: "hanya berasal dari Thailand" is fine, but the English says "originates from Thailand only", so "Asal: hanya Thailand" could be clearer. This is a minor point.
Item 6: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' adds a specific claim; 'biologically immature' is better rendered 'akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis'. Minor.
Item 2: 'berhulu di Pegunungan Kardamom' changes 'draining' (mengalir dari); acceptable but Cardamom Mountains is usually 'Pegunungan Cardamom'. Minor.
Item 12: 'Pasal 16.1 kode ICZN' is fine, but 'Uniknya' for 'Unusually' should be 'Tidak lazimnya' because 'unik' misstates the meaning.
Item 12: 'tembus cahaya samar (translusen)' is wordy; 'translusen' alone would be enough.

Item 13: 'Ghost glass catfish ... spesies yang belum pernah dideskripsikan' lost the 'so far' sense; 'hingga kini belum dideskripsikan' is more accurate. 'Kini mereka menamainya' should be 'Kini spesies itu telah diberi nama'.
Item 12: 'Bombusch' vs 'Bornbusch' is an inconsistency inherited from the source. Use one spelling or flag it.
Item 14: the references are left in English, which is allowed.
Item 3: "padahal" changes the logic of the original ("as the pikeheads are not only extraordinarily healthy..."). Use a neutral connector such as "karena" or "sebab", or restructure the sentence.
Item 7: "daun beech, daun oak" leaves English tree names in place. Use "daun beech/oak" with a gloss, or "daun pohon ek" and "daun bangkuang/beech" as hobbyists write them.
Item 7: "beberapa cm" for "a few inches" is vague. Give a concrete metric figure, e.g. "sekitar 5–10 cm".
Item 7: "air hitam yang asam ... juga perlu ditiru" puts "juga" in an odd place, and "Ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial. Smooth both for a handbook register.
Item 8: "Akuarium sebaiknya dibuat padat (overcrowded)" is ambiguous. Say it should be stocked fairly densely ("diisi cukup padat"), as the English means stocking density.

Item 10: "Jika memutuskan untuk memindahkan betina" changes the source. The English says "the fish", not specifically the female. The source also has fry harassed by the males, but the translation says the female is harassed by the males. Fix to match the original.
Item 10: "menyebarkan agresi" is unnatural for "dissipate this aggression". Use "mengalihkan/mengurangi agresi".
Item 10: "peternak" for "breeders" is better as "pembudidaya" or "breeder" in hobby usage.
Item 10: "memungutnya untuk disatukan dengan telur di mulutnya" is unclear. "them" refers to the egg spots, so make that explicit.
Item 10: "burayak" for fry is less used among hobbyists than "anakan". Also, "memuntahkan telur/burayak" adds "telur", though the source has only "brood".
Item 4: "meskipun lebih besar lebih baik" is awkward. Use "lebih besar lebih disarankan".
Item 3: "karang-karang batu" for "reefs" is odd for a freshwater lake. Use "gugusan/terumbu batu".
Item 1: "hibrida" in brackets after "kawin silang" is redundant. Also "Red zebra" reads better with the article dropped or as "ikan red zebra".
Item 15/16: "barbir" is not the term hobbyists use. Use "barb".
Item 19: "pakan yang melayang" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off. "Pakan yang tidak langsung tenggelam" or "pakan hidup yang berenang bebas" would be clearer.
Item 21: "sangat dirugikan oleh perdagangan" is awkward. Say "perdagangan ikan hias berdampak sangat merugikan".
Item 1: English says 2.5 to 4 cm (1 to 1.5 inches); Indonesian is fine on units, but 'cukup merepotkan' for 'difficult at times' is vague and slightly shifts meaning; use 'kadang sulit dipelihara'.

Item 8: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is awkward; use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum siklus)'. 'sungai atau aliran berarus' is awkward; use 'sungai atau anak sungai berarus'.
Item 15: 'paling baik dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)' is ambiguous and can be misread as keeping a single fish. Use 'dipelihara dalam kelompok satu spesies'.
Item 16: 'bertubuh lebih tinggi' for 'deeper-bodied' is acceptable. 'jantan yang tubuhnya lebih ramping' for 'more compact' changes meaning; use 'lebih kompak'.
Item 4: The type locality quote is left in English; either translate it or mark it clearly as an untranslated citation. Also the coordinate typo is in the source.
Item 7: 60×30 cm 'sekitar 54 liter' implies a 30 cm height that the source does not state; this is fine if the source says it, but check the figure.
Item 3: 'Mae Khlong dan Mae Klong' repeats the same river under two spellings; this matches the source, but a note is needed.
Item 17/11: 'aquascape hardscape' is a redundant mix; use 'aquascape bergaya hardscape' or 'akuarium hardscape'. 'java moss' should be written 'lumut jawa (java moss)'.
Item 13: 'sebagian besar diberi pakan hidup' is fine, but 'fare' is rendered loosely. Item 6: 'Mustura' appears to be a typo for Mustura in the source; leave it.
Item 9 vs 10: source figures conflict (pH 6.0–7.2, 20–25 °C vs 3.5–6.5, 23–26 °C), but the translation is faithful. No change needed there, so only the issues below.
Item 1: "Least Concern" is left in English. Use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" or "Berisiko Rendah".
Item 11: "Sediakan arus air yang kuat" is faithful, but item 8 says torrent-like flow is unnecessary. This is a source inconsistency, so keep it as is.
Item 14: "Pseudomugil" is rendered "Spesies Pseudomugil", which is fine. The "Ikan danionin" wording is slightly awkward. Consider "danionin" alone or "ikan sejenis danio".
Item 15: "geografis tidak dipermasalahkan" loses the sense of "if geography isn't an issue". Better: "jika asal geografis tidak menjadi kendala".
Item 12: "Sayuran yang direbus sebentar" is fine. "Soilent Green" is fine.
Item 5: "merumput biofilm" is awkward. Better: "memakan biofilm" or "mengerok biofilm".
Item 17: "setup tema sungai" is added wording. The source says "mature, heavily seasoned river setups". Better: "setup bergaya sungai yang sudah matang dan lama berjalan".

Item 4: "dan negara bagian Perak" is unclear and could be read as a separate list item. Rephrase as "hutan rawa gambut Selangor Utara di negara bagian Selangor, serta negara bagian Perak di barat laut".
Item 20: "diakui ... valid" and "anggota balitorid sebelumnya" read stiffly. Consider "banyak yang dulu tergolong balitorid".
Section 7: "garam laut khusus akuarium laut" is fine, but "Never use ordinary aquarium salt" became "garam ikan biasa"; use "garam akuarium biasa".
Section 2: "can make a great pet" became "sangat menarik"; "peliharaan yang bagus" is closer.
Section 12: "pasang purnama" for "spring tides" is imprecise; use "pasang tertinggi (pasang purnama/perbani)" or "pasang perbani".
Section 12: "di cabang-cabang (divertikula) yang bercabang" is redundant, so reword it.
Section 1/6: Mixed English terms "Setup" and "Spider crab" are left untranslated; "Setup" could be "Penataan" or "Tipe set-up".
Section 9: "Kepiting ini tidak aman dengan tanaman" is awkward; use "tidak aman dipelihara bersama tanaman".
Section 9: "Pemberian pakan dilakukan setiap hari" and "leaves can stay in the tank for weeks" are acceptable, but "sayuran hijau berdaun" is redundant.

Item 2: "secara pasti diketahui dari ... Samudra Hindia bagian barat laut" is fine, but "sesekali di delta Sungai Mekong" mistranslates "rarely" (jarang). Use "jarang ditemukan di delta Sungai Mekong". The same error appears in item 5.
Item 10: "Least Concern" is rendered as "Risiko Rendah". The usual Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Rendah" (Least Concern). Check this against the IUCN Indonesian term.
Item 10: "Netuma ... berarti 'tari'" is acceptable. "ikan lele laut" for a marine catfish (Ariidae) is fine, but "yang dideskripsikan dari Laut Merah" is a fragment. Rephrase it as a full clause.

Item 5: "Typically euryhaline" is rendered as "Umumnya bersifat eurihalin". This is fine, but the added gloss "(tahan rentang salinitas yang lebar)" is not in the source. Remove it or keep it knowingly.
Item 4: "perairan tawar" is slightly inconsistent with "air tawar" in the first sentence. Use "air tawar" in both places.

Item 8: the sentence 'While smaller tankmates are unlikely to be preyed on similarly-sized cyprinids, characins, catfish...' is garbled. The translation 'pilihan yang mungkin lebih baik adalah cyprinid, characin, dan catfish yang ukurannya sebanding' changes the logic. The English says smaller tankmates are unlikely to be eaten, and that similarly-sized fish are better choices. Rewrite so the two…
Item 8: 'Ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama yang berukuran lebih kecil' is clumsy for 'smaller tankmates'. Use 'ikan lain yang lebih kecil dalam akuarium yang sama'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'cacing darah' and 'aufwuchs' are left as is. Gloss aufwuchs, e.g. 'lapisan perifiton/aufwuchs'.

Item 5: 'diam melayang' for 'hang' is slightly odd. 'Substrat pasir yang halus' is fine, but 'kayu beech (Fagus) atau oak' adds a Latin genus that is not in the source. Remove '(Fagus)' or keep it neutral.
Item 1/11: 'ikan cyprinid' and 'catfish', 'characin' are left in English. Prefer 'ikan suku Cyprinidae', 'lele/ikan kucing', 'karasin' or add a gloss.
Item 11: 'sungut moncong (rostral) dan sungut rahang atas (maksila)' and 'tenggorokan (isthmus)' are technically loose. 'Isthmus' is better rendered as 'istmus/bagian dada di antara insang'.
Item 11: 'Kelompok ini ... disebut shark minnow (ikan hiu-hiuan kecil)' is an invented gloss. Use 'shark minnow' with no made-up Indonesian name.
Item 8: "Asian aquariums" was translated as "akuarium biotop Asia". "biotop" is an added fact, because the source does not say biotope. Use "akuarium Asia".

Item 18: the translation says "Ikan dari Singapura dan Johor tersebut mungkin sebenarnya adalah Pangio muraeniformis". The English says "The former", meaning the Singapore/Johor fish, so this is probably fine. The sentence is still ambiguous, so reconsider it.
Item 18: "palang gelap" is used for "bar" and "tanda berbentuk pelana" for "saddle". Both are acceptable but unusual. Consider "garis/balok" and "pelana" consistently.
Item 18: the conjunction "dan ia memilih nama pengganti Pangio dibandingkan sinonim..." is awkward. Rephrase it, e.g. "dan ia memilih nama pengganti Pangio daripada sinonim bersamaannya, Apua".
Item 18: the citations "Kottelat and Lim, 1993" and "Tan and Kottelat, 2009" are left in English "and". Elsewhere the translation uses "dan". Make them consistent, e.g. "Kottelat dan Lim, 1993".
Item 6: "anak sungai yang tenang/genangan tepi sungai (backwater)" is clumsy. Use a single term such as "anak sungai berarus tenang (backwater)".
Item 6: "P. angullaris" is copied from the source's typo. Leave it, or flag it.

Item 3 and item 9: "tutup akuarium yang rapat" and "lubang hisap filter" are acceptable. "Kuhli loach" and "coolie loach" are not translated consistently in item 1 ("kuhli loach"), and item 18 uses 'kuhli'/'coolie' loach. This is minor.
