Item 11: "hampir tidak pernah ditemui dalam bentuk tetra emas tangkapan liar" drops the point that this is a rummynose tetra, which is withheld until the next sentence. The English says "in a tetra". Also "kilauan emas ini tidak dapat diwarisi dalam baka ternakan" is awkward for "cannot be fixed in breeding strains"; use "tidak boleh dikekalkan dalam baka".
Item 11: "Atas sebab-sebab yang dinyatakan" is fine, but the original sentence structure about guanine was split and 'affected' reworded, so check meaning stays the same.
Item 12: "tidak boleh diinfleksikan" is a poor rendering of 'indeclinable'; use a clearer term such as "tidak berubah bentuk" (kata nama tak terbitan/tidak berinfleksi).

Item 12: "Kilauan emas ini... 'sirip dubur jernih'" fine, but "pangkal ekor" for 'caudal peduncle' and "Monofili" are acceptable; "margin posterodorsal rawan etmoid dan etmoid lateral berjauhan dari etmoid lateral" preserves the source's odd text but is unreadable; consider a note.
Item 10: "Tangki berasingan perlu disediakan" drops "to do so" nuance and "It can be spawned in a group" is fine; "semalap yang mungkin" should be "semalap mungkin".
Item 10: "makanan hidup dan sejuk beku yang berkhasiat" adds "berkhasiat" (nutritious), which is not in the English.
Item 1: 'warna merah itu menjadi pudar pada ikan yang kurang sihat' – source says 'poor condition'; acceptable, but 'Of the three look-alikes...' fine. No major issue.
Item 10: 'It can be spawned in a group, with half a dozen specimens of each sex' – fine; but 'Kondisikan ikan' is awkward; use 'Beri makanan berkhasiat untuk mematangkan ikan' instead.

Item 12: 'Faktor ketiga ... Dengan menggabungkan faktor-faktor ini, ikan anda sepatutnya boleh dikenal pasti' ok; but 'margin posterodorsal rawan etmoid dan etmoid lateral berjauhan dari etmoid lateral' repeats source oddity; fine.
Item 12: 'Rekonstruksi filogenetik ... sampel kajian tersebut dari Sungai Purus' – source says 'our samples'; fine.

Item 11: 'justeru pada satu spesies tetra' is awkward and 'hanya beberapa ekor ... terkesan dengan fenomena ini, iaitu guanin...' garbles the sentence structure; rephrase: 'fenomena ini ialah apabila guanin ... dirembeskan pada kadar jauh lebih tinggi'.
Item 11: 'bukan jangkitan parasit' – fine; 'kilauan emas ini tidak boleh ditetapkan dalam baka ternakan' – use 'tidak dapat diwarisi/dikekalkan dalam baka'.
Item 8: 'tidak akan sihat jika jumlahnya tidak mencukupi' – better 'tidak akan membesar dengan baik/akan tertekan'; 'sangat aman' – use 'sangat cenderung aman/tidak agresif'.
Item 5: 'tukar air separa setiap minggu adalah wajib' – OK; 'kayu beech ... selamat digunakan asalkan dikeringkan sepenuhnya' fine.
Item 4: "68 liter" is fine, but the original's "18 US gal" conversion is OK. No fix needed there.
Item 8: "Corydoras or smaller Loricariids" kept as "Loricariid yang lebih kecil"; consider a clearer term such as "ikan pembersih (Loricariidae) yang lebih kecil".
Item 10: "setengah dozen ekor bagi setiap jantina" is awkward; use "enam ekor bagi setiap jantina".
Item 10: "Matangkan ikan-ikan ini ... sebagai makanan penggalak pembiakan" adds a gloss not in the source; trim it.
Item 10: "gH 1-5" was rendered "GH 1–5" with no unit; this is fine, but "jaring" for mesh and "Saiz lubangnya" is a slight paraphrase of "grade".
Item 10: "Biasanya mereka akan bertelur" adds "Biasanya" (usually) where the source says "should spawn"; use "sepatutnya bertelur".
Item 10: "sangat perlahan" for "bubbling away very gently" is clumsy; use "menggelegak dengan sangat perlahan".
Item 1: the "Hardy and inexpensive" clause is fine. Item 1 and 5: "peat" and "beech" are left in English; add Malay forms such as "gambut" and "kayu beech" on first mention.
Item 9: "membesar sedikit lebih besar" is repetitive; use "cenderung tumbuh sedikit lebih besar".
Item 11: "genus 'serba boleh'" is a poor rendering of "catch-all"; use "genus longgokan/rakus bagi characin kecil" or "kategori pelbagai guna".

Item 10: 'GH 1–5' is fine, but 'pH 5.5–6.5' etc. OK; main issue: 'Siapkan mereka dengan banyak makanan hidup' – 'condition' mistranslated as 'siapkan'; use 'matangkan/berikan makanan penggalak pembiakan'.
Item 10: 'Menapis air melalui peat memang berguna' – 'memang' adds emphasis not in source; and 'gelembung yang sangat perlahan' is awkward; use 'gelembung udara yang sangat perlahan'.
Item 8: 'ikan angelfish' redundant; use 'ikan angelfish' or 'angelfish' without 'ikan' and keep consistent; 'hidup berkawan (shoaling)' is awkward, use 'hidup berkumpulan'.
Item 8: 'akan jauh lebih sihat' is slightly different from 'fare much better' but acceptable; 'Sentiasa beli' should be 'Sentiasa beli' → 'Belilah sentiasa sekumpulan'.
Item 2: 'jangan harap untuk jumpa spesimen liar' is colloquial and 'UK' retained; use 'jangan mengharapkan spesimen liar dijual' and clarify 'di UK' as local context.
Item 5: 'kayu beech', 'peat', 'tangki yang terlalu kosong' (spartan) – use 'tangki yang minimalis/kurang hiasan'; 'tumbuhan akuatik' should be 'tumbuhan akuarium/air'.
Item 5: 'Kalau tak jumpa' and 'Kalau anda' are too colloquial for a handbook; use 'jika tidak'.
Item 1: 'Max size ... SL' omitted imperial is fine, but 'jadi ia antara pilihan terbaik' reads slightly awkward.
Item 1: "paling luar biasa" for "most uncharacteristic" reads as "most extraordinary", which sounds positive. Use "paling tidak tipikal" or "paling lain daripada kumpulannya".
Item 1: "tetapi ia juga wakil" adds "juga", which is not in the English. Use "tetapi ia merupakan wakil yang paling tidak tipikal".
Items 1 and 5: "luar biasa" for "untypical" has the same problem. Use "tidak lazim" or "tidak tipikal bagi Heros".
Item 4: "suka memakan" for "known to devour" is a bit soft. "Makan rakus" or "memakan habis" is closer, and "tumbuhan akuatik" could be "tumbuhan akuarium".
Item 13: 'diisi dengan air matang' for 'mature water' is wrong. In Malay 'air matang' means boiled water. Use 'air akuarium yang telah matang/dikitar' or 'air daripada akuarium matang'.
Item 10: 'mencarikkan sedikit sirip' adds 'sedikit', which the English does not have. 'Ruffle' is also better rendered as 'mengoyak/mencabik sirip'.
Item 13: 'dimatangkan untuk pembiakan' / 'dimatangkan dengan baik' is a loose rendering of 'conditioned'. 'Dikondisikan' or 'disediakan untuk membiak' reads more naturally.
Item 11: 'lasak dan kasar' for 'boisterous' and 'Ikan yang tegap' for 'robust' are slightly awkward. Use 'lasak/lincah' and 'ikan yang tahan lasak'.
Item 11: 'open water-dwelling characids' is rendered 'berenang di bahagian tengah air' (mid-water), which changes the meaning. Use 'menghuni air terbuka'.

Item 11: 'with no other upper water species' is rendered 'tanpa spesies lain yang menghuni bahagian atas air', which is fine. But 'Jika asal-usul geografi tidak menjadi isu' adds 'asal-usul'. Use 'Jika geografi bukan isu'.

Item 10: 'ruffle each other's fins' is rendered 'merosakkan sirip sesama sendiri' (damage). This is a bit strong. Also 'sangat cantik untuk ditonton' for the rivalries is awkward and reads as a literal translation.
Item 14: 'crystal-red color' is rendered 'warna merah yang jernih'. This is unnatural. Use 'merah kristal'.

Item 2/15: the 'long-finned' and 'balloon' strain names are left in English without a Malay gloss, while 'fairy-fin' and 'metallic' are also left in English. Consider giving a Malay gloss, e.g. 'sirip panjang', 'belon'.
Item 4: 'di tebing sungai Amazon' adds 'tebing' (bank), which the source does not say. The source says 'on the Amazon river'. Use 'di sungai Amazon'.

Item 1: 'ikan yang hidup berkumpulan' is fine, but 'hierarki sosial' is acceptable. Item 7: 'tangki yang dihias lengkap' is fine. However, 'Penambahan daun kering akan lagi menonjolkan' is awkward. Use 'akan menambah lagi'.
Item 13: 'Ikan ini membiak secara bebas' for 'free spawner' is imprecise, and 'dikondisikan' is a non-standard borrowing. Use 'didedahkan kepada keadaan pembiakan' or 'dimatangkan'.
Item 4: "Taman Negara Noel Kempff Mercado" – in Malaysia "Taman Negara" is a specific proper name; use "Taman Negara" with care or "Taman Kebangsaan Noel Kempff Mercado".
Item 11: "berlatarbelakangkan" is non-standard; write "berlatar belakangkan" or rephrase (e.g. "dengan latar warna hijau tumbuhan").
Item 15: "lebih banyak lebih bagus" is slightly literal; "lebih ramai lebih meriah" or "semakin banyak semakin baik" is more natural.
Item 2: "tangki" used for aquarium inconsistently with "akuarium"; keep one term for consistency.
"yang ada di mana-mana" for "ubiquitous" is a little stiff. Consider "yang begitu lazim" or "yang sangat meluas dalam hobi".
"Pengeram mulut oleh induk betina" is slightly awkward. "Pengeram mulut maternal" or "Betina mengeram telur dalam mulut" would read more naturally.
"mengutip tompok itu ke dalam mulut bersama telurnya" is clumsy. "cuba memasukkan tompok itu ke dalam mulut bersama telur" would be clearer.
Item 7: '5 to 10-gallon' converted to '19–38 liter' is fine, but item 8: 'unheated' etc fine. Real issue in item 9: none.
Item 10: English gives 70–83°F (21–28°C); fine. No issue.
Item 17: 'Persenyawaan biasanya berlaku' - 'Spawning' means pemijahan/bertelur; 'persenyawaan' (fertilisation) changes meaning.
Item 17: 'milt' left untranslated; use 'sperma/air mani ikan (milt)'.
Item 17: 'sehingga telur ikan betina habis' ok, but 'dibiarkan di dalam tangki' for 'in situ' is fine; 'Tukar air patut dibuat' awkward - use 'Pertukaran air hendaklah sedikit dan kerap'.
Item 17: 'nauplii artemia' and 'microworm' left in English; add 'cacing mikro' and use 'nauplius artemia'.
Item 19: 'suborder Anabantoidei' left as English; use 'subordo'. 'suprabranchial/epibranchial' left untranslated; clarify as 'organ suprabrankial'.
Item 19: 'menghirup udara' - use 'menyedut/bernafas udara atmosfera'.
Item 4: 'Sangat meluas dan tersebar secara meluas' is redundant; rephrase.
Item 14: 'ikan laga' for bettas fine; 'hierarki' for 'pecking order' - use 'susunan kuasa/hierarki pematukan'.
Item 4: "ikan ini haiwan yang tahan lasak" is awkward; use "ikan ini sangat tahan lasak" or "ialah haiwan yang tahan lasak".
Item 4: "g garam/liter" mixes the unit styles; use "g garam/L" or "g garam seliter".
Item 7: "sebarang keagresifan teragih dalam kumpulan" is clumsy; use "supaya keagresifan terbahagi/tersebar dalam kumpulan".
Item 7: "incompatible with conspecifics" is rendered as "agresif". This slightly changes the meaning; "tidak serasi dengan sesama spesies" is closer.
Item 6: "ia disarankan diberi makan" is stiff and passive; use "disarankan memberi makan beberapa kali sehari dalam bahagian kecil".
Item 1: "Ikan mono" is fine, but "magnificent" is rendered as plain "cantik"; "menawan" would be closer.

Item 4: "mulai 10–15 g garam/liter" renders "from 10-15 g" oddly; "mulai" implies a start point but a range is given. Use "pada kira-kira 10–15 g garam seliter" or "dari 10–15 g garam/liter" to match the original.
Item 4: "sangat tahan lasak" adds emphasis. The English says only "robust", so use "tahan lasak".
Item 4: "sebaiknya ikan ini dipelihara untuk sementara waktu sahaja" is acceptable, but "if possible" is lost. Use "jika boleh, ... hanya buat sementara".
Item 7: "keagresifan dapat tersebar" is awkward. Use "supaya sebarang keagresifan terbahagi/teragih dalam kumpulan".
Item 7: "ikan sejenisnya" for conspecifics is acceptable, but "sangat tidak serasi" is stiff. Use "agresif terhadap sesama spesies".
Item 1: "Ikan mono" is a local name for Monodactylus, but "magnificent" is rendered as "sangat cantik", which is acceptable. Consider adding "(moonies)" in brackets on first use.
Item 3: "sangat suka berenang" is acceptable, but "eager to swim" is better as "sangat aktif berenang".
Item 8: "dari luaran" is awkward. Use "secara luaran" or "daripada rupa luaran".

Item 11: "a few feet in length" was rendered as "60–90 cm". A few feet is about 90 cm or more, and item 1 says the fish easily tops 90 cm. This understates the adult size. Use something like "beberapa kaki (sekitar 90 cm atau lebih)" or "lebih 90 cm".
Item 10: "akhir musim bunga dan bulan-bulan musim panas" is literal and sounds odd for Malaysian readers. Consider "akhir musim bunga dan musim panas" (or "hujung musim bunga hingga musim panas").

Item 5: "cukup berat supaya tidak teralih atau diikat kemas pada tangki dengan apa cara sekalipun" garbles the advice. The English says the decor must be too heavy to move OR be secured to the tank. Suggested: "Pastikan semua hiasan cukup berat sehingga tidak boleh digerakkan, atau dipasang kukuh pada tangki".

Item 5: "melompat keluar dari permukaan air" changes "breaches the surface". It implies jumping out of the tank, but the source says the fish breaks the surface. Suggested: "menerjah/melompat ke permukaan air", which also explains why a heavy cover is needed.
Item 6: "(GH)" is added after "kekerasan air", which is not in the source. The unit "°H" is also inconsistent with the GH/dGH wording; use "dGH" or "°dH" consistently.

Item 4: "liter" could be "liter" or "litre"; keep it consistent with the other items. "mana-mana tangki kecuali yang sangat besar" is slightly awkward; "hanya sesuai untuk tangki yang sangat besar" is more natural.
Item 8: "very vigorous" is translated as "terlalu aktif". This is slightly off, because "vigorous" here means boisterous or robust. "Lasak" or "agresif" would be more accurate.
Item 10: "intensifying in the colour" is translated as "menjadi lebih terang". "Lebih pekat" or "lebih garang" would be closer, since the colour deepens rather than brightens.

Item 10: "Beri ikan dewasa makanan yang baik ... untuk menyediakan mereka membiak, dan biasanya ikan akan bertelur" – 'Condition' is rendered awkwardly. Rephrase, e.g. "Kondisikan ikan dewasa dengan diet berkualiti ... dan pembiakan biasanya berlaku".

Item 10: "ikan keli" for catfish bottom dwellers is misleading, because it suggests the food fish keli (Clarias). Use "ikan hampulang/ikan kucing" or "catfish" in the aquarium sense, e.g. "ikan catfish dasar".

Item 10: "Jika air terlalu beralkali ... kebanyakan anak cenderung menjadi jantan" – the source says 'too acidic and the opposite is true', so females dominate. The Malay is fine, but "sebaliknya" should be made clear as 'kebanyakan betina'.

Item 10: "Pada masa ini pasangan itu perlu diperhatikan ... ada betina yang boleh menyerang" is fine. However, "Anak ikan patut dibiarkan bersama induknya sehingga ... jika tidak" adds the nuance "jika tidak" and loosens the original structure. Make it explicit: 'leave until signs of next spawn, otherwise the male may turn aggressive'.
Item 11: "Kebanyakan besar Kribensis" is ungrammatical. Use "Sebahagian besar Kribensis" or "Majoriti Kribensis".
Item 11: "bentuk albino yang muncul dalam akuarium" is a loose rendering of 'aquarium sport albino form'. Use "mutasi albino (sport)".

Item 4: The source gives 24" x 15" x 12", which converts to about 61 x 38 x 30 cm. 60 x 37.5 x 30 cm is the source's own metric figure, so it is fine. However, "Tangki ... sesuai" drops the 'single pair' nuance, which should be "sepasang ikan sahaja".
Item 16: "well-researched community aquarium" is rendered as "dirancang dengan teliti" (carefully planned). Use "yang dikaji dengan baik" or "yang dirancang berdasarkan kajian". This is minor.
Item 4/5: "feral" is left as "populasi feral". Item 3 gives a gloss, but "populasi liar yang terlepas" would read more naturally.
Item 21: "pasangan Afrika kepada tetra Amerika Selatan" – "pasangan" reads as a mated couple; use "setara" or "padanan Afrika" for "counterpart".
Item 21: "pertunjukan mengurat" is too colloquial for courtship displays; use "pertunjukan percumbuan" or "gelagat mengawan".
Item 17: "sirip yang lebih menarik" and "sirip yang menarik" are vague for "elaborate fins"; use "sirip yang lebih rumit/berhias".
Item 1: "Warnanya akan timbul" is a bit awkward; "warnanya semakin terserlah" is more natural.
"Sebenarnya, hiasan tidak diperlukan": "Strictly speaking" is better as "Secara tegasnya" or "Secara teknikalnya". "Sebenarnya" on its own is slightly off.
"lancefish" is left in English. Use a Malay name or add a short gloss.
"hutan yang dinaiki air" is a bit stiff. "hutan banjir" or "hutan yang dibanjiri air" is more natural.
Item 10: "boleh mudah dijangkiti" is awkward; use "mudah dijangkiti" or "cenderung dijangkiti".
Item 17: "menayangkan diri kepada betina" is unnatural for courtship display; use "mempamerkan diri" or "menunjuk-nunjuk".
Items 8 and 17: "tangki bertumbuhan" and "kawasan bertumbuhan padat" are non-standard; use "tangki bertanaman" or "ditanam dengan tumbuhan akuatik" and "kawasan tumbuhan padat".
Item 17: "sangat cepat membiak" for "incredibly prolific" is acceptable but flat; "sangat subur membiak" is more natural.
Item 4: the source says 'Liposarcus pardalis' but item 11 says the genus is now Pterygoplichthys. The translation keeps the source's Liposarcus, which is fine. Consider no change.
Item 3: 'Kerana itulah lebih seronok lagi' is slightly informal and loosely renders 'All the more beautiful'. Consider 'Oleh itu, lebih menarik lagi untuk memperoleh...'.
Item 11: 'tersalah dijual' is awkward for 'miss sold'. Use 'sering dijual secara salah sebagai' or 'sering tersilap dilabel sebagai'.
Item 11: 'tahun sembilan puluhan' is slightly clumsy. Use 'awal tahun 1990-an'.
Item 7: 'membesar terlalu besar' is repetitive. Use 'tumbuh terlalu besar'. 'tangki' is fine, but 'akuarium' is more common in Malaysia.
Item 10: the English term 'flake' is left in the Malay text. Use 'makanan kepingan (flake)' or similar.
Item 17: "diisi dengan air matang" – in Malay "air matang" usually means boiled water. Use "air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)" or similar.
Item 17: "Kumpulan dewasa boleh dirangsang (conditioning)" is awkward. Use "dikondisikan" or "diberi makanan penyubur" instead.
Item 13: "ikan rainbow" is acceptable, but "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)" would be clearer for readers. "Bersaiz sama" is better than "sama saiz".
Item 12: "roughage" is rendered as "makanan berserat", but daphnia and brine shrimp are not fibre sources. Keep the sense of "roughage" and check the wording.
Item 10: "sisik dari vent hingga sisik interpelvis" leaves English "vent" in place. Use "dubur" or "lubang dubur".
Item 10: "gill-raker" (twice) is left in English. Use "sikat insang" or "gill raker (sikat insang)".
Item 10: "baris sisik pipi bermod 6 (4-7)" is stiff and hard to read. Use "biasanya 6 (4-7)" for "modally 6".
